text: Topik ini menerangkan pengertian sejarah sebagai kajian tentang masa lalu dan bagaimana peristiwa lama membentuk masyarakat hari ini.
text_en: This topic explains the meaning of history as the study of the past and how past events shape society today.

text: Sejarah ialah kajian tentang peristiwa, manusia, dan keadaan pada masa lalu.
text_en: History is the study of events, people, and conditions in the past.

text: Sejarah membantu menjelaskan bagaimana masyarakat berubah dari masa ke masa.
text_en: History helps explain how societies change over time.

text: Pengertian sejarah boleh berbeza tetapi biasanya berkaitan dengan bukti dan interpretasi masa lalu.
text_en: The meaning of history can vary but usually relates to evidence and interpretation of the past.

text: Sejarah melibatkan kajian masa silam untuk memahami masa kini dan masa depan.
text_en: History involves studying the past to understand the present and the future.

text: Kajian sejarah memerlukan sumber seperti dokumen, artifak, dan cerita lisan.
text_en: Historical study requires sources such as documents, artifacts, and oral stories.

text: Perkataan sejarah berasal daripada perkataan Arab 'syajaratun' yang bermaksud pokok, melambangkan salasilah dan asal usul.
text_en: The word 'sejarah' comes from the Arabic 'syajaratun', meaning tree, symbolising genealogy and origins.

text: Dalam bahasa Yunani, 'historia' bermaksud penyelidikan atau pencarian maklumat tentang sesuatu peristiwa.
text_en: In Greek, 'historia' means inquiry or the search for information about an event.

text: Beliau mentakrifkan sejarah sebagai catatan atau rekod tentang sesuatu peristiwa yang berlaku pada masa lalu dan melibatkan manusia serta masyarakatnya. Takrifan beliau banyak dirujuk dalam penulisan sejarah tempatan.
text_en: He defined history as a record of past events involving human beings and their societies. His definition is widely cited in Malaysian historical writing.

text: Perkataan 'sejarah' berasal daripada perkataan Arab yang membawa maksud apa? / The word 'sejarah' comes from an Arabic word meaning what?
choice_a: Pokok / Tree
choice_b: Sungai / River
choice_c: Batu / Stone
choice_d: Bintang / Star
answer: Pokok / Tree

text: Apakah maksud sejarah? / What is the meaning of history?
choice_a: Kajian tentang peristiwa masa lalu yang berasaskan bukti / The study of past events based on evidence
choice_b: Ramalan tentang peristiwa masa hadapan / Predictions about future events
choice_c: Kajian tentang bentuk muka bumi / The study of landforms
choice_d: Cerita rekaan tentang manusia purba / Fictional stories about early humans
answer: Kajian tentang peristiwa masa lalu yang berasaskan bukti / The study of past events based on evidence

text: Perkataan 'historia' dalam bahasa Yunani membawa maksud / The Greek word 'historia' means
choice_a: Penyelidikan atau pencarian maklumat / Inquiry or the search for information
choice_b: Tulisan indah / Beautiful writing
choice_c: Peperangan besar / A great war
choice_d: Perjalanan jauh / A long journey
answer: Penyelidikan atau pencarian maklumat / Inquiry or the search for information

text: Mengapakah sejarah penting kepada sesebuah negara? / Why is history important to a nation?
choice_a: Untuk memupuk semangat patriotik dan jati diri bangsa / To nurture patriotism and national identity
choice_b: Untuk meningkatkan hasil pertanian / To increase agricultural yields
choice_c: Untuk menentukan cuaca setiap hari / To determine the daily weather
choice_d: Untuk mengira jumlah penduduk semasa / To count the current population
answer: Untuk memupuk semangat patriotik dan jati diri bangsa / To nurture patriotism and national identity

text: Antara berikut, yang manakah BUKAN ciri sesuatu yang boleh dianggap sejarah? / Which of the following is NOT a feature of something that can be regarded as history?
choice_a: Peristiwa itu direka tanpa sebarang bukti / The event is invented without any evidence
choice_b: Peristiwa itu benar-benar berlaku / The event actually happened
choice_c: Peristiwa itu penting dan memberi kesan / The event is significant and has an impact
choice_d: Peristiwa itu boleh dibuktikan dengan sumber / The event can be proven with sources
answer: Peristiwa itu direka tanpa sebarang bukti / The event is invented without any evidence

text: Jelaskan satu sebab mengapa sejarah penting bagi generasi muda. / Explain one reason why history is important for young people.
answer: Sejarah membantu generasi muda belajar daripada kesilapan lalu dan membuat keputusan yang lebih baik untuk masa depan. / History helps young people learn from past mistakes and make better decisions for the future.

text: Nyatakan asal usul perkataan 'sejarah' dan maksudnya. / State the origin of the word 'sejarah' and its meaning.
answer: Perkataan sejarah berasal daripada perkataan Arab 'syajaratun' yang bermaksud pokok, melambangkan salasilah keturunan yang berkembang seperti dahan pokok. / The word comes from the Arabic 'syajaratun', meaning tree, symbolising a family lineage that branches out like a tree.

text: Berikan dua ciri sesuatu peristiwa yang boleh diterima sebagai sejarah. / Give two features of an event that can be accepted as history.
answer: Peristiwa itu benar-benar berlaku dan boleh dibuktikan dengan sumber, serta penting kerana memberi kesan kepada masyarakat. / The event genuinely occurred and can be proven with sources, and it is significant because it affects society.

text: Topik ini menerangkan bahawa sejarawan memberikan definisi sejarah berdasarkan penemuan bukti, tafsiran, dan perspektif masa lalu.
text_en: This topic explains that historians define history based on evidence, interpretation, and past perspectives.

text: Sejarawan mengkaji dokumen, catatan, dan bukti lain untuk membina pemahaman tentang masa lalu.
text_en: Historians study documents, records, and other evidence to build an understanding of the past.

text: Sejarawan sering menemui dokumen lama, catatan rasmi dan artifak yang membuka maklumat baharu tentang kehidupan masyarakat dahulu.
text_en: Historians often discover old documents, official records, and artifacts that reveal new information about past societies.

text: Penemuan catatan sejarah seperti surat, prasasti atau laporan rasmi membantu ahli sejarah membina semula peristiwa dengan lebih tepat.
text_en: Findings such as letters, inscriptions, or official reports help historians reconstruct events more accurately.

text: Pendekatan sejarawan membantu menjelaskan bagaimana peristiwa dan manusia dikaji secara sistematik.
text_en: A historian's approach helps explain how events and people are studied systematically.

text: Sejarah bukan sekadar cerita, tetapi satu proses analisis bukti untuk membuat kesimpulan.
text_en: History is not just stories, but a process of analyzing evidence to draw conclusions.

text: Ahli sejarah menggunakan sumber primer dan sekunder untuk memahami konteks peristiwa.
text_en: Historians use primary and secondary sources to understand the context of events.

text: Herodotus menulis 'The Histories' berdasarkan pemerhatian dan temu bual, menjadikannya karya sejarah bertulis yang awal.
text_en: Herodotus wrote 'The Histories' based on observation and interviews, making it one of the earliest works of written history.

text: Sejarawan yang berbeza memberikan definisi yang berbeza kerana latar belakang budaya dan zaman mereka berbeza.
text_en: Different historians give different definitions because their cultural backgrounds and eras differ.

text: Melalui karyanya Muqaddimah, beliau memperkenalkan konsep 'ilm al-umran' iaitu kajian tentang pola kebangkitan dan kejatuhan masyarakat. Beliau menekankan sejarah bukan sekadar cerita, tetapi analisis sebab dan akibat.
text_en: Through his work Muqaddimah he introduced 'ilm al-umran', the study of patterns in the rise and fall of societies. He stressed that history is not merely storytelling but an analysis of cause and effect.

text: Karya terkenal Ibn Khaldun ialah / Ibn Khaldun's famous work is
choice_a: Muqaddimah
choice_b: The Histories
choice_c: Politeia / The Republic
choice_d: Shi Ji
answer: Muqaddimah

text: Herodotus dikenali sebagai / Herodotus is known as
choice_a: Bapa Sejarah Barat / The Father of Western History
choice_b: Bapa Perubatan / The Father of Medicine
choice_c: Bapa Algebra / The Father of Algebra
choice_d: Bapa Falsafah Timur / The Father of Eastern Philosophy
answer: Bapa Sejarah Barat / The Father of Western History

text: Konsep 'ilm al-umran' yang diperkenalkan oleh Ibn Khaldun merujuk kepada / The concept 'ilm al-umran' introduced by Ibn Khaldun refers to
choice_a: Kajian tentang perkembangan dan kejatuhan masyarakat / The study of the development and decline of societies
choice_b: Kajian tentang bintang dan planet / The study of stars and planets
choice_c: Kajian tentang bahasa purba / The study of ancient languages
choice_d: Kajian tentang tumbuhan ubatan / The study of medicinal plants
answer: Kajian tentang perkembangan dan kejatuhan masyarakat / The study of the development and decline of societies

text: Mengapakah definisi sejarah berbeza antara sejarawan? / Why do definitions of history differ between historians?
choice_a: Kerana latar belakang, zaman dan tafsiran mereka berbeza / Because their backgrounds, eras and interpretations differ
choice_b: Kerana mereka tidak membaca sumber / Because they do not read sources
choice_c: Kerana sejarah tidak mempunyai bukti / Because history has no evidence
choice_d: Kerana definisi sejarah ditetapkan oleh kerajaan / Because definitions of history are set by governments
answer: Kerana latar belakang, zaman dan tafsiran mereka berbeza / Because their backgrounds, eras and interpretations differ

text: Antara berikut, yang manakah persamaan pandangan kebanyakan sejarawan tentang sejarah? / Which of the following is common to most historians' views of history?
choice_a: Sejarah mesti berasaskan bukti yang boleh disemak / History must be based on verifiable evidence
choice_b: Sejarah mesti ditulis dalam satu bahasa sahaja / History must be written in one language only
choice_c: Sejarah hanya merekod kehidupan raja / History records only the lives of kings
choice_d: Sejarah tidak memerlukan tafsiran / History requires no interpretation
answer: Sejarah mesti berasaskan bukti yang boleh disemak / History must be based on verifiable evidence

text: Berikan satu contoh bukti yang boleh mengubah tafsiran sejarah. / Give one example of evidence that can change historical interpretation.
answer: Penemuan dokumen baharu atau artifak arkeologi boleh mengubah cara sejarawan mentafsir peristiwa lalu. / The discovery of a new document or archaeological artifact can change how historians interpret past events.

text: Nyatakan sumbangan Ibn Khaldun terhadap penulisan sejarah. / State Ibn Khaldun's contribution to historical writing.
answer: Beliau memperkenalkan pendekatan analisis melalui konsep 'ilm al-umran' yang mengkaji sebab kebangkitan dan kejatuhan sesebuah masyarakat. / He introduced an analytical approach through 'ilm al-umran', which examines the causes of the rise and fall of societies.

text: Bandingkan pandangan Herodotus dan Ibn Khaldun tentang sejarah. / Compare the views of Herodotus and Ibn Khaldun on history.
answer: Herodotus menumpukan pengumpulan cerita dan laporan saksi tentang peristiwa, manakala Ibn Khaldun menekankan analisis pola dan sebab perubahan masyarakat. / Herodotus focused on collecting accounts and witness reports of events, while Ibn Khaldun emphasised analysing patterns and causes of social change.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Topik ini menerangkan konsep masa dan ruang dalam sejarah, iaitu bagaimana peristiwa berlaku dalam konteks waktu dan tempat tertentu.
text_en: This topic explains the concepts of time and space in history, meaning how events occur within a specific time and place.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Masa merujuk kepada jangka waktu di mana peristiwa berlaku.
text_en: Time refers to the period during which events happen.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Ruang merujuk kepada lokasi atau tempat di mana peristiwa berlaku.
text_en: Space refers to the location or place where events occur.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Analisis sejarah memerlukan pemahaman tentang hubungan antara masa dan ruang.
text_en: Historical analysis requires understanding the relationship between time and space.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Sejarah boleh menunjukkan perubahan dalam masyarakat pada waktu dan tempat tertentu.
text_en: History can show changes in society at particular times and places.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Peristiwa sejarah mesti ditempatkan dalam konteks masa dan ruang yang betul.
text_en: Historical events must be placed in the correct time and space context.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Konsep masa dalam sejarah dibahagikan kepada masa lalu, masa kini dan masa hadapan yang saling berkaitan.
text_en: The concept of time in history is divided into past, present and future, which are interconnected.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Ruang dalam sejarah membolehkan kita memahami mengapa sesuatu peristiwa berlaku di sesuatu tempat tertentu.
text_en: Space in history allows us to understand why an event took place in a particular location.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Beliau berpendapat sejarah ialah dialog berterusan antara sejarawan masa kini dengan fakta masa lalu. Pandangan ini menekankan bahawa masa lalu sentiasa ditafsir semula mengikut persoalan zaman sekarang.
text_en: He argued that history is a continuous dialogue between the historian of today and the facts of the past. This view stresses that the past is constantly reinterpreted according to present-day questions.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Apakah maksud 'ruang' dalam kajian sejarah? / What does 'space' mean in historical study?
choice_a: Lokasi atau tempat sesuatu peristiwa berlaku / The location or place where an event occurred
choice_b: Jarak antara dua bintang / The distance between two stars
choice_c: Jumlah masa yang diambil untuk satu peristiwa / The amount of time an event takes
choice_d: Bilangan orang yang terlibat / The number of people involved
answer: Lokasi atau tempat sesuatu peristiwa berlaku / The location or place where an event occurred

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Garis masa digunakan dalam sejarah untuk / A timeline is used in history to
choice_a: Menyusun peristiwa mengikut urutan kronologi / Arrange events in chronological order
choice_b: Menentukan kebenaran sesuatu sumber / Determine the truth of a source
choice_c: Mengukur luas sesebuah kawasan / Measure the size of an area
choice_d: Menyenaraikan nama sejarawan / List the names of historians
answer: Menyusun peristiwa mengikut urutan kronologi / Arrange events in chronological order

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Mengapakah konsep masa penting dalam sejarah? / Why is the concept of time important in history?
choice_a: Kerana ia menunjukkan urutan dan hubungan sebab akibat antara peristiwa / Because it shows the sequence and cause-and-effect links between events
choice_b: Kerana ia menentukan cuaca semasa peristiwa / Because it determines the weather during an event
choice_c: Kerana ia menggantikan keperluan kepada sumber / Because it replaces the need for sources
choice_d: Kerana ia menjadikan sejarah lebih pendek / Because it makes history shorter
answer: Kerana ia menunjukkan urutan dan hubungan sebab akibat antara peristiwa / Because it shows the sequence and cause-and-effect links between events

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Istilah 'Masihi' dan 'Sebelum Masihi' digunakan untuk / The terms 'AD' and 'BC' are used to
choice_a: Menandakan pembahagian tahun dalam kalendar sejarah / Mark the division of years in the historical calendar
choice_b: Menamakan dua jenis sumber sejarah / Name two types of historical source
choice_c: Membezakan sejarah dan mitos / Distinguish history from myth
choice_d: Menandakan dua benua yang berbeza / Mark two different continents
answer: Menandakan pembahagian tahun dalam kalendar sejarah / Mark the division of years in the historical calendar

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Kajian tentang ruang membantu sejarawan memahami / The study of space helps historians understand
choice_a: Pengaruh kedudukan geografi terhadap sesuatu peristiwa / The influence of geographical position on an event
choice_b: Umur sebenar seorang tokoh / The exact age of a figure
choice_c: Bahasa yang digunakan dalam dokumen / The language used in documents
choice_d: Jumlah buku yang ditulis tentang peristiwa itu / The number of books written about the event
answer: Pengaruh kedudukan geografi terhadap sesuatu peristiwa / The influence of geographical position on an event

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Nyatakan maksud ruang dalam sejarah dalam satu ayat. / State the meaning of space in history in one sentence.
answer: Ruang dalam sejarah merujuk kepada lokasi atau tempat sesuatu peristiwa berlaku. / Space in history refers to the location or place where an event occurs.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Mengapakah garis masa penting dalam pembelajaran sejarah? / Why is a timeline important in learning history?
answer: Garis masa menyusun peristiwa mengikut urutan supaya pelajar dapat melihat hubungan sebab dan akibat antara peristiwa. / A timeline arranges events in order so that learners can see the cause-and-effect relationships between them.

topic: 1.3 Masa Silam dan Ruang dalam Sejarah
text: Jelaskan hubungan antara masa lalu, masa kini dan masa hadapan. / Explain the relationship between past, present and future.
answer: Peristiwa masa lalu mempengaruhi keadaan masa kini, dan pengajaran daripada kedua-duanya membantu manusia merancang masa hadapan. / Past events shape present conditions, and lessons from both help people plan for the future.

text: Topik ini membincangkan jenis sumber sejarah seperti sumber bertulis, lisan, dan artifak yang membantu kita memahami masa lalu.
text_en: This topic discusses types of historical sources such as written, oral, and artifact sources that help us understand the past.

text: Sumber sejarah adalah bahan yang memberi maklumat tentang masa lalu.
text_en: Historical sources are materials that provide information about the past.

text: Sumber primer ialah bahan asal yang dibuat semasa peristiwa berlaku, seperti dokumen rasmi, surat, atau artifak.
text_en: Primary sources are original materials created during the event, such as official documents, letters, or artifacts.

text: Sumber sekunder ialah kajian atau ulasan tentang masa lalu yang ditulis kemudian, seperti buku sejarah dan artikel.
text_en: Secondary sources are studies or reviews of the past written later, such as history books or articles.

text: Sumber bertulis, lisan, dan artifak boleh menjadi primer atau sekunder bergantung pada bagaimana ia digunakan.
text_en: Written, oral, and artifact sources can be primary or secondary depending on how they are used.

text: Ahli sejarah mengutamakan sumber primer untuk bukti langsung dan menggunakan sumber sekunder untuk konteks dan tafsiran.
text_en: Historians prioritize primary sources for direct evidence and use secondary sources for context and interpretation.

text: Sumber primer ialah sumber asli yang dihasilkan pada zaman peristiwa itu berlaku, seperti batu bersurat dan surat rasmi.
text_en: Primary sources are original materials produced at the time of the event, such as inscribed stones and official letters.

text: Sumber sekunder ialah sumber yang dihasilkan kemudian berdasarkan sumber primer, seperti buku teks dan artikel jurnal.
text_en: Secondary sources are produced later based on primary sources, such as textbooks and journal articles.

text: Beliau mengembara ke banyak wilayah untuk mengumpul cerita, laporan saksi dan pemerhatian sendiri sebelum menulis tentang Perang Parsi. Kaedah mengumpul sumber inilah yang menjadikan beliau digelar Bapa Sejarah.
text_en: He travelled to many regions to collect accounts, witness reports and his own observations before writing about the Persian Wars. This method of gathering sources earned him the title Father of History.

text: Antara berikut, yang manakah contoh sumber primer? / Which of the following is an example of a primary source?
choice_a: Batu bersurat / An inscribed stone
choice_b: Buku teks sekolah / A school textbook
choice_c: Ensiklopedia / An encyclopaedia
choice_d: Artikel akhbar tahun 2020 tentang zaman purba / A 2020 newspaper article about ancient times
answer: Batu bersurat / An inscribed stone

text: Sumber sekunder ialah sumber yang / A secondary source is one that
choice_a: Dihasilkan kemudian berdasarkan sumber asal / Is produced later based on original sources
choice_b: Ditulis oleh saksi peristiwa itu sendiri / Is written by a witness to the event
choice_c: Tidak boleh digunakan dalam kajian sejarah / Cannot be used in historical study
choice_d: Sentiasa lebih tepat daripada sumber primer / Is always more accurate than a primary source
answer: Dihasilkan kemudian berdasarkan sumber asal / Is produced later based on original sources

text: Sumber lisan merujuk kepada / Oral sources refer to
choice_a: Cerita dan pengalaman yang disampaikan melalui percakapan / Stories and experiences conveyed through speech
choice_b: Rekod yang diukir pada batu / Records carved on stone
choice_c: Gambar foto lama / Old photographs
choice_d: Peta lukisan tangan / Hand-drawn maps
answer: Cerita dan pengalaman yang disampaikan melalui percakapan / Stories and experiences conveyed through speech

text: Mengapakah sejarawan perlu menyemak kesahihan sumber? / Why must historians verify the authenticity of sources?
choice_a: Kerana sumber boleh berat sebelah atau palsu / Because sources can be biased or forged
choice_b: Kerana semua sumber adalah sama nilainya / Because all sources are of equal value
choice_c: Kerana sumber primer tidak perlu dianalisis / Because primary sources need no analysis
choice_d: Kerana sumber lisan sentiasa benar / Because oral sources are always true
answer: Kerana sumber boleh berat sebelah atau palsu / Because sources can be biased or forged

text: Artifak seperti alat batu dan tembikar tergolong dalam sumber / Artifacts such as stone tools and pottery are classified as
choice_a: Sumber primer berbentuk bahan / Material primary sources
choice_b: Sumber sekunder bertulis / Written secondary sources
choice_c: Sumber lisan / Oral sources
choice_d: Sumber rekaan / Fabricated sources
answer: Sumber primer berbentuk bahan / Material primary sources

text: Apakah perbezaan utama antara sumber bertulis dan sumber lisan? / What is the main difference between written sources and oral sources?
answer: Sumber bertulis direkodkan dalam bentuk dokumen, manakala sumber lisan disampaikan melalui cerita atau ucapan. / Written sources are recorded in documents, while oral sources are conveyed through stories or speech.

text: Berikan dua contoh sumber primer dan dua contoh sumber sekunder. / Give two examples of primary sources and two of secondary sources.
answer: Sumber primer: batu bersurat dan artifak seperti alat batu. Sumber sekunder: buku teks dan artikel jurnal sejarah. / Primary: inscribed stones and artifacts such as stone tools. Secondary: textbooks and historical journal articles.

text: Mengapakah sumber perlu dinilai sebelum digunakan? / Why must sources be evaluated before use?
answer: Sumber mungkin berat sebelah, tidak lengkap atau palsu, jadi penilaian memastikan fakta yang digunakan sahih. / Sources may be biased, incomplete or forged, so evaluation ensures the facts used are authentic.

text: Topik ini menjelaskan kaedah penyelidikan sejarah seperti kaedah bertulis, kaedah lisan, dan kaedah arkeologi untuk mengumpulkan maklumat tentang masa lalu.
text_en: This topic explains historical research methods like written, oral, and archaeological methods for gathering information about the past.

text: Penyelidikan sejarah menggunakan dokumen bertulis untuk mencari bukti masa lalu.
text_en: Historical research uses written documents to find evidence of the past.

text: Kaedah lisan melibatkan wawancara dan cerita tradisi.
text_en: Oral methods involve interviews and traditional stories.

text: Kaedah arkeologi menganalisis artifak dan struktur yang ditemui.
text_en: Archaeological methods analyze artifacts and structures that are found.

text: Gabungan beberapa kaedah membantu menghasilkan kajian sejarah yang lebih lengkap.
text_en: Combining several methods helps produce more complete historical research.

text: Penyelidikan sejarah memerlukan ketelitian dalam menilai kesahihan sumber.
text_en: Historical research requires care in assessing the validity of sources.

text: Kaedah penyelidikan sejarah merangkumi pengumpulan data, penilaian sumber, tafsiran dan penulisan laporan.
text_en: Historical research methods include collecting data, evaluating sources, interpreting them and writing a report.

text: Kaedah lisan melalui temu bual sering digunakan untuk merekod pengalaman yang tidak terdapat dalam dokumen.
text_en: The oral method through interviews is often used to record experiences not found in documents.

text: Beliau menulis sejarah Perang Peloponnesus dengan menyemak silang laporan saksi dan menolak cerita dewa-dewi sebagai sebab peristiwa. Kaedah kritis beliau menjadi asas penyelidikan sejarah yang objektif.
text_en: He wrote the history of the Peloponnesian War by cross-checking witness accounts and rejecting tales of the gods as causes of events. His critical method became a foundation for objective historical research.

text: Langkah pertama dalam penyelidikan sejarah ialah / The first step in historical research is
choice_a: Menentukan tajuk dan persoalan kajian / Determining the topic and research questions
choice_b: Menulis laporan akhir / Writing the final report
choice_c: Mencetak hasil kajian / Printing the findings
choice_d: Membentangkan kajian di sekolah / Presenting the study at school
answer: Menentukan tajuk dan persoalan kajian / Determining the topic and research questions

text: Kaedah temu bual paling sesuai digunakan untuk mendapatkan / The interview method is most suitable for obtaining
choice_a: Maklumat lisan daripada saksi atau orang yang terlibat / Oral information from witnesses or those involved
choice_b: Data cuaca purba / Ancient weather data
choice_c: Umur mutlak sesuatu artifak / The absolute age of an artifact
choice_d: Salinan dokumen rasmi / Copies of official documents
answer: Maklumat lisan daripada saksi atau orang yang terlibat / Oral information from witnesses or those involved

text: Kajian lapangan dalam sejarah bermaksud / Fieldwork in history means
choice_a: Melawat tapak atau lokasi sejarah untuk mengumpul maklumat / Visiting a historical site to gather information
choice_b: Membaca buku di perpustakaan sahaja / Reading books in the library only
choice_c: Menulis semula buku teks / Rewriting a textbook
choice_d: Menghafal fakta penting / Memorising important facts
answer: Melawat tapak atau lokasi sejarah untuk mengumpul maklumat / Visiting a historical site to gather information

text: Mengapakah rujukan perlu dinyatakan dalam laporan kajian sejarah? / Why must references be stated in a historical research report?
choice_a: Untuk menunjukkan sumber fakta dan mengelakkan plagiarisme / To show the source of facts and avoid plagiarism
choice_b: Untuk memanjangkan laporan / To lengthen the report
choice_c: Untuk menyembunyikan sumber asal / To hide the original sources
choice_d: Untuk menggantikan kesimpulan / To replace the conclusion
answer: Untuk menunjukkan sumber fakta dan mengelakkan plagiarisme / To show the source of facts and avoid plagiarism

text: Antara berikut, yang manakah menunjukkan sikap objektif seorang penyelidik sejarah? / Which of the following shows the objective attitude of a historical researcher?
choice_a: Menyemak fakta daripada beberapa sumber sebelum membuat kesimpulan / Checking facts from several sources before concluding
choice_b: Memilih hanya bukti yang menyokong pendapat sendiri / Choosing only evidence that supports one's own opinion
choice_c: Menolak semua sumber lisan / Rejecting all oral sources
choice_d: Menyalin bulat-bulat pendapat orang lain / Copying others' opinions wholesale
answer: Menyemak fakta daripada beberapa sumber sebelum membuat kesimpulan / Checking facts from several sources before concluding

text: Senaraikan tiga langkah dalam kaedah penyelidikan sejarah. / List three steps in the historical research method.
answer: Menentukan tajuk dan persoalan kajian, mengumpul serta menilai sumber, dan mentafsir data sebelum menulis laporan. / Determining the topic and research questions, collecting and evaluating sources, and interpreting the data before writing the report.

text: Jelaskan kepentingan kajian lapangan dalam penyelidikan sejarah. / Explain the importance of fieldwork in historical research.
answer: Kajian lapangan membolehkan penyelidik memerhati tapak dan artifak secara langsung serta mendapatkan maklumat yang tiada dalam dokumen. / Fieldwork lets researchers observe sites and artifacts directly and obtain information not available in documents.

text: Mengapakah seorang penyelidik sejarah perlu bersikap objektif? / Why must a historical researcher be objective?
answer: Sikap objektif memastikan tafsiran dibuat berdasarkan bukti dan bukan perasaan atau kepentingan peribadi, supaya hasil kajian boleh dipercayai. / Objectivity ensures interpretation is based on evidence rather than feelings or personal interest, so the findings can be trusted.

text: Topik ini menerangkan bentuk fizikal Bumi, kawasan daratan, lautan, dan bagaimana alam sekitar membentuk kehidupan manusia.
text_en: This topic explains the physical form of Earth, land areas, seas, and how the environment shapes human life.

text: Bumi terdiri daripada kawasan daratan, lautan, gunung, dan kawasan sejuk.
text_en: Earth consists of land, oceans, mountains, and cold regions.

text: Pembentukan fizikal Bumi mempengaruhi taburan haiwan, tumbuhan, dan manusia.
text_en: Earth's physical formation affects the distribution of animals, plants, and humans.

text: Lautan dan daratan menjadi penanda arah pergerakan manusia dan perdagangan.
text_en: Oceans and land became routes for movement and trade.

text: Perubahan bentuk muka bumi menghasilkan perbezaan iklim dan sumber makanan.
text_en: Changes in the landscape created differences in climate and food sources.

text: Pengetahuan tentang dunia membantu kita memahami perubahan alam sekitar.
text_en: Knowledge about the world helps us understand environmental change.

text: Bumi terbentuk kira-kira 4.6 bilion tahun dahulu dan permukaannya berubah secara berterusan.
text_en: The Earth formed about 4.6 billion years ago and its surface changes continuously.

text: Pergerakan plat tektonik menyebabkan pembentukan benua, banjaran gunung dan lautan.
text_en: The movement of tectonic plates causes the formation of continents, mountain ranges and oceans.

text: Beliau memperkenalkan teori pergerakan benua pada tahun 1912 dan mencadangkan bahawa semua benua pernah bercantum sebagai Pangaea. Teori ini membantu menjelaskan bentuk dunia yang kita lihat hari ini.
text_en: He introduced the theory of continental drift in 1912, proposing that all continents were once joined as Pangaea. The theory helps explain the shape of the world we see today.
person_role: Ahli sains iklim dan geofizik Jerman

text: Teori pergerakan benua menyatakan bahawa benua pada asalnya / The theory of continental drift states that the continents were originally
choice_a: Bercantum sebagai satu daratan besar / Joined as one large landmass
choice_b: Terpisah seperti keadaan sekarang / Separated as they are today
choice_c: Berada di bawah laut sepenuhnya / Entirely under the sea
choice_d: Terbentuk daripada hujan meteor / Formed from meteor showers
answer: Bercantum sebagai satu daratan besar / Joined as one large landmass

text: Nama daratan besar yang dicadangkan oleh Alfred Wegener ialah / The name of the supercontinent proposed by Alfred Wegener is
choice_a: Pangaea
choice_b: Sundaland
choice_c: Gondwana Baru / New Gondwana
choice_d: Laurasia Kecil / Little Laurasia
answer: Pangaea

text: Perubahan permukaan bumi berlaku terutamanya disebabkan oleh / Changes to the Earth's surface occur mainly because of
choice_a: Pergerakan plat tektonik dan proses hakisan / Tectonic plate movement and erosion
choice_b: Perubahan warna langit / Changes in the colour of the sky
choice_c: Pergerakan bintang / The movement of stars
choice_d: Pertambahan penduduk dunia / Growth of the world population
answer: Pergerakan plat tektonik dan proses hakisan / Tectonic plate movement and erosion

text: Bumi dianggarkan terbentuk kira-kira / The Earth is estimated to have formed about
choice_a: 4.6 bilion tahun dahulu / 4.6 billion years ago
choice_b: 10 juta tahun dahulu / 10 million years ago
choice_c: 100 ribu tahun dahulu / 100 thousand years ago
choice_d: 5 ribu tahun dahulu / 5 thousand years ago
answer: 4.6 bilion tahun dahulu / 4.6 billion years ago

text: Mengapakah pelajar sejarah perlu memahami pembentukan bumi? / Why should history students understand the formation of the Earth?
choice_a: Kerana bentuk muka bumi mempengaruhi tempat manusia awal tinggal / Because landforms influenced where early humans lived
choice_b: Kerana ia menentukan bahasa yang digunakan manusia / Because it determines the language humans use
choice_c: Kerana ia menggantikan kajian sumber sejarah / Because it replaces the study of historical sources
choice_d: Kerana ia menerangkan asal usul tulisan / Because it explains the origin of writing
answer: Kerana bentuk muka bumi mempengaruhi tempat manusia awal tinggal / Because landforms influenced where early humans lived

text: Jelaskan secara ringkas teori pergerakan benua. / Briefly explain the theory of continental drift.
answer: Teori ini menyatakan bahawa benua pada asalnya bercantum sebagai satu daratan besar bernama Pangaea sebelum bergerak perlahan-lahan ke kedudukan sekarang. / The theory states that the continents were once joined as a single landmass called Pangaea before slowly drifting to their present positions.

text: Nyatakan dua proses yang mengubah permukaan bumi. / State two processes that change the Earth's surface.
answer: Pergerakan plat tektonik yang membentuk gunung dan lautan, serta hakisan oleh air dan angin. / Tectonic plate movement that forms mountains and oceans, and erosion by water and wind.

text: Mengapakah kedudukan geografi penting dalam kajian sejarah awal manusia? / Why is geographical position important in the study of early human history?
answer: Kedudukan geografi menentukan sumber makanan, iklim dan laluan pergerakan manusia awal, lalu mempengaruhi cara hidup mereka. / Geographical position determines food sources, climate and migration routes, and thus shapes how early humans lived.

text: Topik ini menerangkan konsep zaman air batu, iaitu tempoh ketika suhu Bumi menjadi lebih sejuk dan kawasan besar dilitupi ais.
text_en: This topic explains the concept of the Ice Age, a period when Earth's temperature became colder and large areas were covered by ice.

text: Zaman air batu ialah tempoh cuaca sejuk yang meliputi kawasan besar di Bumi.
text_en: The Ice Age was a period of cold weather that covered large areas of Earth.

text: Semasa zaman air batu, banyak kawasan yang kini panas menjadi sejuk dan dilitupi ais.
text_en: During the Ice Age, many areas that are now warm became cold and covered with ice.

text: Kitaran perubahan suhu menyebabkan zon ais berkembang dan surut secara berulang.
text_en: Cycles of temperature change caused ice zones to expand and shrink repeatedly.

text: Perubahan suhu ini memberi kesan besar kepada tumbuhan, haiwan, dan manusia.
text_en: These temperature changes had major effects on plants, animals, and humans.

text: Zaman air batu membentuk landskap, sungai, dan bentuk muka bumi yang kita lihat hari ini.
text_en: The Ice Age shaped landscapes, rivers, and landforms that we see today.

text: Zaman Air Batu ialah tempoh apabila suhu bumi menurun dan sebahagian besar permukaan bumi diliputi glasier.
text_en: The Ice Age was a period when the Earth's temperature fell and much of its surface was covered by glaciers.

text: Paras air laut menurun semasa Zaman Air Batu kerana banyak air tersimpan dalam bentuk ais.
text_en: Sea levels fell during the Ice Age because much water was locked up as ice.

text: Beliau memperkenalkan teori Zaman Air Batu pada tahun 1837 selepas mengkaji kesan glasier di Pergunungan Alps. Kajian beliau membuktikan bahawa ais pernah meliputi kawasan yang jauh lebih luas daripada hari ini.
text_en: He introduced the theory of the Ice Age in 1837 after studying glacial traces in the Alps. His research proved that ice once covered a far wider area than today.

text: Apakah yang dimaksudkan dengan Zaman Air Batu? / What is meant by the Ice Age?
choice_a: Tempoh suhu bumi menurun dan glasier meluas / A period when Earth's temperature fell and glaciers expanded
choice_b: Tempoh gunung berapi meletus di seluruh dunia / A period of worldwide volcanic eruptions
choice_c: Tempoh air laut naik menenggelami benua / A period when seas rose and submerged continents
choice_d: Tempoh hutan hujan meliputi seluruh bumi / A period when rainforest covered the whole Earth
answer: Tempoh suhu bumi menurun dan glasier meluas / A period when Earth's temperature fell and glaciers expanded

text: Semasa Zaman Air Batu, paras air laut / During the Ice Age, sea levels
choice_a: Menurun kerana air tersimpan sebagai ais / Fell because water was stored as ice
choice_b: Naik kerana glasier mencair / Rose because glaciers melted
choice_c: Kekal sama seperti hari ini / Remained the same as today
choice_d: Naik dan turun setiap hari / Rose and fell every day
answer: Menurun kerana air tersimpan sebagai ais / Fell because water was stored as ice

text: Siapakah yang memperkenalkan teori Zaman Air Batu? / Who introduced the theory of the Ice Age?
choice_a: Louis Agassiz
choice_b: Alfred Wegener
choice_c: Charles Darwin
choice_d: Eugene Dubois
answer: Louis Agassiz

text: Kesan Zaman Air Batu terhadap manusia awal ialah / An effect of the Ice Age on early humans was
choice_a: Mereka berpindah mencari kawasan yang lebih panas dan sumber makanan / They migrated in search of warmer areas and food sources
choice_b: Mereka membina bandar besar / They built large cities
choice_c: Mereka mula bercucuk tanam secara besar-besaran / They began large-scale farming
choice_d: Mereka berhenti menggunakan alat batu / They stopped using stone tools
answer: Mereka berpindah mencari kawasan yang lebih panas dan sumber makanan / They migrated in search of warmer areas and food sources

text: Bukti kewujudan Zaman Air Batu boleh dikesan melalui / Evidence of the Ice Age can be traced through
choice_a: Kesan hakisan glasier dan lapisan batuan / Glacial erosion marks and rock layers
choice_b: Catatan bertulis manusia purba / Written records of early humans
choice_c: Peta moden / Modern maps
choice_d: Cerita rakyat sahaja / Folk tales alone
answer: Kesan hakisan glasier dan lapisan batuan / Glacial erosion marks and rock layers

text: Nyatakan maksud Zaman Air Batu. / State the meaning of the Ice Age.
answer: Zaman Air Batu ialah tempoh apabila suhu bumi menurun sehingga sebahagian besar permukaan bumi diliputi glasier dan litupan ais. / The Ice Age was a period when the Earth's temperature dropped so that much of its surface was covered by glaciers and ice sheets.

text: Jelaskan mengapa paras air laut menurun semasa Zaman Air Batu. / Explain why sea levels fell during the Ice Age.
answer: Sejumlah besar air tersimpan dalam bentuk ais dan glasier di daratan, menyebabkan kurang air kembali ke laut. / A large amount of water was locked up as ice and glaciers on land, so less water returned to the sea.

text: Berikan satu bukti yang menunjukkan Zaman Air Batu pernah berlaku. / Give one piece of evidence showing the Ice Age occurred.
answer: Kesan hakisan glasier pada batuan dan lembah berbentuk U di kawasan pergunungan menunjukkan pergerakan ais pada masa lalu. / Glacial erosion marks on rocks and U-shaped valleys in mountain areas show past ice movement.

text: Topik ini menerangkan garis masa zaman air batu dan perubahan suhu yang berlaku secara berperingkat.
text_en: This topic explains the timeline of the Ice Age and the gradual changes in temperature that took place.

text: Garis masa menunjukkan perubahan suhu dari masa ke masa.
text_en: The timeline shows changes in temperature over time.

text: Pada tahap tertentu, suhu menurun lalu ais berkembang di kawasan tertentu.
text_en: At certain points, temperatures dropped and ice expanded in some regions.

text: Pada tahap lain, suhu meningkat lalu ais mula surut.
text_en: At other points, temperatures rose and ice began to retreat.

text: Perubahan ini berlaku berulang dan mengambil masa yang sangat lama.
text_en: These changes occurred repeatedly over a very long period.

text: Garis masa membantu kita memahami urutan perubahan geografi dan iklim.
text_en: The timeline helps us understand the sequence of geographic and climatic changes.

text: Zaman Air Batu terbahagi kepada beberapa fasa sejuk (glasier) dan fasa panas (interglasier) secara berulang.
text_en: The Ice Age is divided into repeated cold phases (glacials) and warm phases (interglacials).

text: Zaman Air Batu Akhir berakhir kira-kira 10 000 tahun dahulu apabila suhu bumi meningkat.
text_en: The Last Ice Age ended about 10,000 years ago when the Earth's temperature rose.

text: Beliau menjelaskan bahawa perubahan orbit dan kecondongan paksi bumi menyebabkan kitaran sejuk dan panas yang berulang. Teori kitaran ini membantu ahli sains menyusun garis masa Zaman Air Batu.
text_en: He explained that changes in the Earth's orbit and axial tilt cause repeating cold and warm cycles. This cycle theory helps scientists construct the timeline of the Ice Age.

text: Fasa panas antara dua fasa glasier dikenali sebagai / The warm phase between two glacial phases is known as
choice_a: Interglasier / Interglacial
choice_b: Pleistosen / Pleistocene
choice_c: Holosen / Holocene
choice_d: Paleolitik / Palaeolithic
answer: Interglasier / Interglacial

text: Zaman Air Batu Akhir berakhir kira-kira / The Last Ice Age ended about
choice_a: 10 000 tahun dahulu / 10,000 years ago
choice_b: 1 juta tahun dahulu / 1 million years ago
choice_c: 500 tahun dahulu / 500 years ago
choice_d: 100 juta tahun dahulu / 100 million years ago
answer: 10 000 tahun dahulu / 10,000 years ago

text: Menurut Milankovic, kitaran sejuk dan panas bumi disebabkan oleh / According to Milankovic, Earth's cold and warm cycles are caused by
choice_a: Perubahan orbit dan kecondongan paksi bumi / Changes in Earth's orbit and axial tilt
choice_b: Pergerakan benua yang pantas / Rapid continental movement
choice_c: Letusan gunung berapi setiap tahun / Annual volcanic eruptions
choice_d: Perubahan warna matahari / Changes in the colour of the Sun
answer: Perubahan orbit dan kecondongan paksi bumi / Changes in Earth's orbit and axial tilt

text: Garis masa Zaman Air Batu penting kerana ia / A timeline of the Ice Age is important because it
choice_a: Menunjukkan urutan perubahan iklim dan kesannya terhadap manusia / Shows the sequence of climate change and its effects on humans
choice_b: Menentukan nama-nama manusia purba / Determines the names of early humans
choice_c: Menunjukkan lokasi bandar purba / Shows the location of ancient cities
choice_d: Mengukur ketinggian gunung / Measures the height of mountains
answer: Menunjukkan urutan perubahan iklim dan kesannya terhadap manusia / Shows the sequence of climate change and its effects on humans

text: Zaman selepas berakhirnya Zaman Air Batu Akhir dikenali sebagai / The era after the Last Ice Age ended is known as
choice_a: Holosen / Holocene
choice_b: Pleistosen / Pleistocene
choice_c: Mesozoik / Mesozoic
choice_d: Jurasik / Jurassic
answer: Holosen / Holocene

text: Apakah perbezaan antara fasa glasier dan fasa interglasier? / What is the difference between a glacial and an interglacial phase?
answer: Fasa glasier ialah tempoh suhu rendah dengan litupan ais yang luas, manakala fasa interglasier ialah tempoh suhu lebih panas apabila ais berundur. / A glacial phase is a cold period with extensive ice cover, while an interglacial is a warmer period when ice retreats.

text: Nyatakan bila Zaman Air Batu Akhir berakhir dan apa yang berlaku selepasnya. / State when the Last Ice Age ended and what followed.
answer: Ia berakhir kira-kira 10 000 tahun dahulu apabila suhu meningkat, ais mencair dan paras laut naik membentuk pantai seperti hari ini. / It ended about 10,000 years ago when temperatures rose, ice melted and sea levels rose to form today's coastlines.

text: Mengapakah ahli sains menggunakan garis masa untuk mengkaji Zaman Air Batu? / Why do scientists use a timeline to study the Ice Age?
answer: Garis masa menyusun fasa sejuk dan panas mengikut urutan supaya hubungan antara perubahan iklim dan perubahan kehidupan manusia dapat dilihat dengan jelas. / A timeline arranges cold and warm phases in order so the link between climate change and changes in human life is clear.

text: Topik ini membincangkan ciri-ciri utama zaman air batu akhir, termasuk kawasan ais, tumbuhan sejuk, dan perubahan cuaca yang ketara.
text_en: This topic discusses the main features of the late Ice Age, including ice-covered areas, cold plants, and significant weather changes.

text: Zaman air batu akhir ditandai dengan kawasan ais yang luas dan suhu yang sangat sejuk.
text_en: The late Ice Age was marked by vast ice-covered regions and very cold temperatures.

text: Tumbuhan yang tahan sejuk lebih dominan di kawasan tertentu.
text_en: Cold-tolerant plants became more dominant in some areas.

text: Haiwan seperti mamalia besar dapat bertahan di kawasan sejuk.
text_en: Animals such as large mammals could survive in cold regions.

text: Bentuk muka bumi berubah akibat hakisan dan pemendapan ais.
text_en: The landscape changed due to erosion and deposition by ice.

text: Kawasan yang kini subur mungkin berubah menjadi tundra atau padang sejuk.
text_en: Areas that are now fertile may have become tundra or cold grasslands.

text: Semasa Zaman Air Batu Akhir, manusia hidup secara nomad dan bergantung kepada memburu serta memungut hasil hutan.
text_en: During the Last Ice Age, humans lived nomadically and relied on hunting and gathering forest produce.

text: Haiwan besar seperti mammoth dan badak berbulu hidup di kawasan sejuk pada zaman ini.
text_en: Large animals such as mammoths and woolly rhinoceroses lived in cold regions during this period.

text: Beliau mencipta kaedah pentarikhan radiokarbon pada tahun 1949 yang membolehkan usia tulang, arang dan artifak zaman ini ditentukan. Kaedah ini menjadikan kajian Zaman Air Batu Akhir jauh lebih tepat.
text_en: He developed radiocarbon dating in 1949, allowing the age of bones, charcoal and artifacts from this period to be determined. The method made the study of the Last Ice Age far more accurate.

text: Cara hidup manusia semasa Zaman Air Batu Akhir ialah / The way of life of humans during the Last Ice Age was
choice_a: Nomad, memburu dan memungut hasil hutan / Nomadic, hunting and gathering
choice_b: Menetap dan bertani secara besar-besaran / Settled and farming on a large scale
choice_c: Berdagang menggunakan mata wang / Trading using currency
choice_d: Tinggal dalam bandar berkubu / Living in fortified cities
answer: Nomad, memburu dan memungut hasil hutan / Nomadic, hunting and gathering

text: Haiwan yang biasa dikaitkan dengan Zaman Air Batu Akhir ialah / An animal commonly associated with the Last Ice Age is
choice_a: Mammoth
choice_b: Dinosaur
choice_c: Unta Arab / Arabian camel
choice_d: Harimau Malaya / Malayan tiger
answer: Mammoth

text: Kaedah pentarikhan radiokarbon digunakan untuk / Radiocarbon dating is used to
choice_a: Menentukan usia bahan organik seperti tulang dan arang / Determine the age of organic material such as bone and charcoal
choice_b: Menentukan suhu udara semasa / Determine current air temperature
choice_c: Mengukur ketebalan glasier hari ini / Measure the thickness of today's glaciers
choice_d: Menterjemah tulisan purba / Translate ancient writing
answer: Menentukan usia bahan organik seperti tulang dan arang / Determine the age of organic material such as bone and charcoal

text: Tempat perlindungan utama manusia pada Zaman Air Batu Akhir ialah / The main shelter of humans in the Last Ice Age was
choice_a: Gua dan pelindung batu / Caves and rock shelters
choice_b: Rumah batu bata / Brick houses
choice_c: Rumah panjang kayu / Wooden longhouses
choice_d: Khemah kain / Cloth tents
answer: Gua dan pelindung batu / Caves and rock shelters

text: Api penting kepada manusia Zaman Air Batu Akhir kerana / Fire was important to Last Ice Age humans because
choice_a: Ia memberi kehangatan, memasak makanan dan menghalau binatang buas / It gave warmth, cooked food and drove away wild animals
choice_b: Ia digunakan untuk membuat logam / It was used to make metal
choice_c: Ia digunakan untuk membakar tembikar perdagangan / It was used to fire trade pottery
choice_d: Ia menerangi bandar pada waktu malam / It lit up cities at night
answer: Ia memberi kehangatan, memasak makanan dan menghalau binatang buas / It gave warmth, cooked food and drove away wild animals

text: Nyatakan dua ciri kehidupan manusia semasa Zaman Air Batu Akhir. / State two features of human life during the Last Ice Age.
answer: Mereka hidup secara nomad berpindah randah mencari makanan, dan berlindung di dalam gua sambil menggunakan api serta alat batu. / They lived nomadically, moving in search of food, and sheltered in caves while using fire and stone tools.

text: Mengapakah manusia zaman ini bergantung kepada gua? / Why did humans of this period depend on caves?
answer: Gua memberi perlindungan daripada cuaca sejuk, hujan dan serangan binatang buas tanpa perlu membina tempat tinggal. / Caves provided shelter from cold weather, rain and wild animals without the need to build dwellings.

text: Jelaskan kegunaan kaedah pentarikhan radiokarbon dalam kajian zaman ini. / Explain the use of radiocarbon dating in studying this period.
answer: Kaedah ini menentukan usia bahan organik seperti tulang dan arang, membolehkan penemuan disusun mengikut garis masa yang tepat. / The method determines the age of organic material such as bone and charcoal, allowing finds to be placed accurately on a timeline.

text: Topik ini menerangkan perubahan bentuk muka bumi dan paras laut akibat penyejukan dan pencairan ais.
text_en: This topic explains changes in landforms and sea level caused by cooling and melting ice.

text: Perubahan iklim menyebabkan paras laut berubah dari masa ke masa.
text_en: Climate change caused sea levels to change over time.

text: Penyejukan menyebabkan laut berkurang dan kawasan daratan terdedah.
text_en: Cooling caused the sea to shrink and exposed more land.

text: Pencairan ais pula meningkatkan paras laut dan mengubah pantai.
text_en: Melting ice raised sea levels and changed coastlines.

text: Perubahan ini mempengaruhi habitat manusia dan haiwan.
text_en: These changes affected the habitats of humans and animals.

text: Landskap yang berubah membentuk laluan baru untuk pergerakan manusia.
text_en: The changing landscape created new routes for human movement.

text: Peningkatan suhu menyebabkan glasier mencair, paras laut naik dan kawasan pantai baharu terbentuk.
text_en: Rising temperatures caused glaciers to melt, sea levels to rise and new coastlines to form.

text: Perubahan iklim menyebabkan tumbuhan dan haiwan baharu muncul, lalu mengubah sumber makanan manusia.
text_en: Climate change brought new plants and animals, which changed human food sources.

text: Beliau memperkenalkan istilah Pleistosen dan Holosen untuk membahagikan zaman geologi berdasarkan perubahan hidupan. Idea beliau bahawa proses alam berlaku secara perlahan dan berterusan membantu menjelaskan perubahan selepas Zaman Air Batu.
text_en: He introduced the terms Pleistocene and Holocene to divide geological time based on changes in living things. His idea that natural processes act slowly and continuously helps explain post-Ice Age change.

text: Kesan utama peningkatan suhu selepas Zaman Air Batu Akhir ialah / The main effect of rising temperatures after the Last Ice Age was
choice_a: Glasier mencair dan paras laut naik / Glaciers melted and sea levels rose
choice_b: Glasier bertambah tebal / Glaciers became thicker
choice_c: Bumi menjadi lebih sejuk / The Earth became colder
choice_d: Daratan bercantum semula / Landmasses joined again
answer: Glasier mencair dan paras laut naik / Glaciers melted and sea levels rose

text: Perubahan iklim selepas Zaman Air Batu menyebabkan manusia mula / Climate change after the Ice Age led humans to begin
choice_a: Menetap dan bercucuk tanam / Settling and farming
choice_b: Berpindah ke kawasan berais / Moving to icy regions
choice_c: Meninggalkan penggunaan api / Abandoning the use of fire
choice_d: Menghentikan aktiviti memburu terus / Stopping hunting entirely
answer: Menetap dan bercucuk tanam / Settling and farming

text: Istilah Holosen merujuk kepada / The term Holocene refers to
choice_a: Zaman selepas berakhirnya Zaman Air Batu hingga kini / The era after the Ice Age up to the present
choice_b: Zaman puncak litupan ais / The peak of ice cover
choice_c: Zaman sebelum kemunculan manusia / The era before humans appeared
choice_d: Zaman dinosaur / The age of dinosaurs
answer: Zaman selepas berakhirnya Zaman Air Batu hingga kini / The era after the Ice Age up to the present

text: Kepupusan haiwan besar seperti mammoth berkait rapat dengan / The extinction of large animals such as mammoths is closely linked to
choice_a: Perubahan iklim dan pemburuan manusia / Climate change and human hunting
choice_b: Letusan gunung berapi di Asia Tenggara / Volcanic eruptions in Southeast Asia
choice_c: Pembinaan bandar awal / The building of early cities
choice_d: Penggunaan logam / The use of metals
answer: Perubahan iklim dan pemburuan manusia / Climate change and human hunting

text: Kenaikan paras laut selepas Zaman Air Batu Akhir menyebabkan / The rise in sea level after the Last Ice Age caused
choice_a: Sebahagian daratan rendah tenggelam dan membentuk pulau / Low-lying land to be submerged, forming islands
choice_b: Gunung menjadi lebih tinggi / Mountains to become higher
choice_c: Sungai mengering sepenuhnya / Rivers to dry up completely
choice_d: Hutan hilang sepenuhnya / Forests to disappear entirely
answer: Sebahagian daratan rendah tenggelam dan membentuk pulau / Low-lying land to be submerged, forming islands

text: Jelaskan dua perubahan alam sekitar selepas Zaman Air Batu Akhir. / Explain two environmental changes after the Last Ice Age.
answer: Glasier mencair sehingga paras laut naik dan menenggelami daratan rendah, serta iklim menjadi lebih panas sehingga tumbuhan dan haiwan baharu muncul. / Glaciers melted so sea levels rose and submerged low-lying land, and the climate warmed so new plants and animals appeared.

text: Bagaimanakah perubahan iklim mempengaruhi cara hidup manusia? / How did climate change affect the human way of life?
answer: Iklim yang lebih panas membolehkan tumbuhan ditanam, lalu manusia mula menetap, bercucuk tanam dan menternak haiwan. / A warmer climate allowed crops to grow, so humans began to settle, farm and domesticate animals.

text: Mengapakah haiwan besar seperti mammoth pupus? / Why did large animals such as the mammoth become extinct?
answer: Habitat sejuk mereka mengecil akibat pemanasan iklim dan mereka turut diburu secara meluas oleh manusia. / Their cold habitat shrank as the climate warmed and they were also widely hunted by humans.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Topik ini menerangkan kesan perubahan zaman air batu terhadap Asia Tenggara, termasuk kawasan daratan yang terdedah dan perubahan ekosistem.
text_en: This topic explains the effects of Ice Age changes in Southeast Asia, including exposed land areas and ecosystem changes.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Perubahan zaman air batu mempengaruhi Asia Tenggara melalui perubahan paras laut dan bentuk muka bumi.
text_en: Ice Age changes affected Southeast Asia through changes in sea level and landforms.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Kawasan daratan yang terdedah membolehkan pergerakan haiwan dan manusia ke kawasan yang berbeza.
text_en: Exposed land areas allowed animals and humans to move to different places.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Ekosistem berubah apabila kawasan sejuk menggantikan kawasan tropika tertentu.
text_en: Ecosystems changed when cold regions replaced some tropical areas.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Perubahan ini mempengaruhi taburan tumbuhan, haiwan, dan masyarakat awal.
text_en: These changes affected the distribution of plants, animals, and early communities.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Kesan zaman air batu masih dapat dilihat dalam bentuk landskap dan taburan sumber.
text_en: The effects of the Ice Age can still be seen in the landscape and distribution of resources.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Semasa paras laut rendah, Pentas Sunda menghubungkan Semenanjung Tanah Melayu dengan Sumatera, Jawa dan Borneo.
text_en: When sea levels were low, the Sunda Shelf connected the Malay Peninsula with Sumatra, Java and Borneo.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Kenaikan paras laut memisahkan daratan tersebut dan membentuk kepulauan Asia Tenggara seperti hari ini.
text_en: Rising sea levels separated these lands and formed the Southeast Asian archipelago as it is today.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Beliau mengkaji prasejarah Asia Tenggara dan penghijrahan manusia awal di rantau Kepulauan Melayu. Kajian beliau menjelaskan bagaimana perubahan paras laut membentuk taburan penduduk di rantau ini.
text_en: He researched Southeast Asian prehistory and early human migration across the Malay Archipelago. His work explains how changing sea levels shaped the region's settlement patterns.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Pentas Sunda ialah / The Sunda Shelf is
choice_a: Daratan yang menghubungkan Semenanjung Tanah Melayu dengan pulau-pulau berdekatan / Land connecting the Malay Peninsula with nearby islands
choice_b: Banjaran gunung di utara Thailand / A mountain range in northern Thailand
choice_c: Sebuah tasik besar di Borneo / A large lake in Borneo
choice_d: Lautan dalam di timur Filipina / A deep ocean east of the Philippines
answer: Daratan yang menghubungkan Semenanjung Tanah Melayu dengan pulau-pulau berdekatan / Land connecting the Malay Peninsula with nearby islands

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Kepulauan Asia Tenggara terbentuk apabila / The Southeast Asian archipelago formed when
choice_a: Paras laut naik dan menenggelami daratan rendah / Sea levels rose and submerged low-lying land
choice_b: Gunung berapi membina pulau baharu sahaja / Volcanoes alone built new islands
choice_c: Manusia menggali terusan / Humans dug canals
choice_d: Plat tektonik berhenti bergerak / Tectonic plates stopped moving
answer: Paras laut naik dan menenggelami daratan rendah / Sea levels rose and submerged low-lying land

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Kesan kenaikan paras laut terhadap manusia awal di Asia Tenggara ialah / An effect of rising sea levels on early humans in Southeast Asia was
choice_a: Mereka terpisah ke pulau berbeza dan berkembang secara berasingan / They were separated onto different islands and developed separately
choice_b: Mereka berhenti menggunakan alat batu / They stopped using stone tools
choice_c: Mereka berpindah ke Eropah / They migrated to Europe
choice_d: Mereka membina piramid / They built pyramids
answer: Mereka terpisah ke pulau berbeza dan berkembang secara berasingan / They were separated onto different islands and developed separately

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Iklim Asia Tenggara selepas Zaman Air Batu menjadi / After the Ice Age, the climate of Southeast Asia became
choice_a: Panas dan lembap dengan hutan hujan yang luas / Hot and humid with extensive rainforest
choice_b: Sejuk dan kering seperti padang pasir / Cold and dry like a desert
choice_c: Berais sepanjang tahun / Icy all year round
choice_d: Bersalji pada musim sejuk / Snowy in winter
answer: Panas dan lembap dengan hutan hujan yang luas / Hot and humid with extensive rainforest

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Bukti kewujudan manusia awal di Asia Tenggara banyak ditemui di / Evidence of early humans in Southeast Asia is largely found in
choice_a: Gua dan tapak arkeologi berhampiran sungai / Caves and archaeological sites near rivers
choice_b: Dasar lautan dalam / The deep ocean floor
choice_c: Puncak gunung berapi / Volcano summits
choice_d: Bandar moden / Modern cities
answer: Gua dan tapak arkeologi berhampiran sungai / Caves and archaeological sites near rivers

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Jelaskan bagaimana kepulauan Asia Tenggara terbentuk. / Explain how the Southeast Asian archipelago was formed.
answer: Apabila ais mencair selepas Zaman Air Batu, paras laut naik dan menenggelami Pentas Sunda sehingga daratan yang bersambung terpisah menjadi pulau. / When ice melted after the Ice Age, sea levels rose and submerged the Sunda Shelf, splitting connected land into islands.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Nyatakan satu kesan perubahan iklim terhadap kehidupan manusia awal di Asia Tenggara. / State one effect of climate change on early human life in Southeast Asia.
answer: Iklim panas dan lembap menyuburkan hutan dan sungai, membolehkan manusia menetap serta bergantung kepada sumber hutan dan air. / A hot, humid climate enriched forests and rivers, allowing humans to settle and rely on forest and water resources.

topic: 2.6 Kesan Perubahan Zaman Air Batu di Asia Tenggara
text: Mengapakah Pentas Sunda penting dalam kajian prasejarah rantau ini? / Why is the Sunda Shelf important in the prehistory of this region?
answer: Pentas Sunda membolehkan manusia dan haiwan bergerak melalui daratan antara wilayah yang kini terpisah oleh laut, menjelaskan persamaan budaya dan hidupan di rantau ini. / The Sunda Shelf let humans and animals move overland between areas now separated by sea, explaining cultural and biological similarities across the region.

text: Topik ini menerangkan maksud zaman prasejarah, pembahagian zaman batu dan zaman logam, serta perkembangan teknologi dan kehidupan manusia awal.
text_en: This topic explains the meaning of the prehistoric age, the division between the Stone Age and Metal Age, and the development of technology and early human life.

text: Zaman prasejarah ialah zaman sebelum manusia mengenal tulisan.
text_en: The prehistoric age is the period before humans knew writing.

text: Zaman ini terbahagi kepada Zaman Batu dan Zaman Logam.
text_en: It is divided into the Stone Age and the Metal Age.

text: Zaman Paleolitik menekankan teknologi batu ringkas dan kehidupan nomad.
text_en: The Palaeolithic Age emphasized simple stone technology and nomadic life.

text: Zaman Mesolitik menonjolkan pemburuan binatang dan penangkapan ikan.
text_en: The Mesolithic Age highlighted animal hunting and fishing.

text: Zaman Neolitik memperlihatkan petempatan menetap, pertanian, penternakan, dan tembikar.
text_en: The Neolithic Age saw settled settlements, farming, animal husbandry, and pottery.

text: Zaman Logam melibatkan inovasi gangsa dan besi, pelayaran, dan perdagangan barter.
text_en: The Metal Age involved bronze and iron innovations, seafaring, and barter trade.

text: Zaman Prasejarah ialah tempoh sebelum wujudnya sistem tulisan, jadi kajiannya bergantung kepada artifak dan tinggalan.
text_en: Prehistory is the period before writing existed, so its study depends on artifacts and remains.

text: Zaman Prasejarah dibahagikan kepada Zaman Paleolitik, Mesolitik, Neolitik dan Zaman Logam.
text_en: Prehistory is divided into the Palaeolithic, Mesolithic, Neolithic and Metal Ages.

text: Beliau memperkenalkan sistem tiga zaman iaitu Zaman Batu, Zaman Gangsa dan Zaman Besi untuk mengelaskan tinggalan prasejarah. Sistem ini masih menjadi asas pembahagian zaman prasejarah hari ini.
text_en: He introduced the three-age system of Stone, Bronze and Iron Ages to classify prehistoric remains. This system is still the basis for dividing prehistory today.

text: Zaman Prasejarah bermaksud tempoh / Prehistory means the period
choice_a: Sebelum manusia mencipta sistem tulisan / Before humans invented writing
choice_b: Sebelum manusia menggunakan api / Before humans used fire
choice_c: Selepas kemunculan tamadun awal / After the rise of early civilisations
choice_d: Selepas Zaman Air Batu berakhir sahaja / Only after the Ice Age ended
answer: Sebelum manusia mencipta sistem tulisan / Before humans invented writing

text: Kajian Zaman Prasejarah bergantung terutamanya kepada / The study of prehistory depends mainly on
choice_a: Artifak, fosil dan tinggalan arkeologi / Artifacts, fossils and archaeological remains
choice_b: Buku catatan raja / Royal chronicles
choice_c: Akhbar lama / Old newspapers
choice_d: Peta bercetak / Printed maps
answer: Artifak, fosil dan tinggalan arkeologi / Artifacts, fossils and archaeological remains

text: Susunan zaman prasejarah yang betul ialah / The correct order of prehistoric periods is
choice_a: Paleolitik, Mesolitik, Neolitik, Zaman Logam / Palaeolithic, Mesolithic, Neolithic, Metal Age
choice_b: Neolitik, Paleolitik, Mesolitik, Zaman Logam / Neolithic, Palaeolithic, Mesolithic, Metal Age
choice_c: Zaman Logam, Neolitik, Paleolitik, Mesolitik / Metal Age, Neolithic, Palaeolithic, Mesolithic
choice_d: Mesolitik, Zaman Logam, Paleolitik, Neolitik / Mesolithic, Metal Age, Palaeolithic, Neolithic
answer: Paleolitik, Mesolitik, Neolitik, Zaman Logam / Palaeolithic, Mesolithic, Neolithic, Metal Age

text: Sistem tiga zaman diperkenalkan oleh / The three-age system was introduced by
choice_a: Christian Jurgensen Thomsen
choice_b: Louis Agassiz
choice_c: Herodotus
choice_d: Gordon Childe
answer: Christian Jurgensen Thomsen

text: Mengapakah zaman ini dinamakan 'prasejarah'? / Why is this period called 'prehistory'?
choice_a: Kerana tiada rekod bertulis ditinggalkan oleh manusia zaman itu / Because no written records were left by the people of that time
choice_b: Kerana tiada manusia hidup pada zaman itu / Because no humans lived then
choice_c: Kerana zaman itu tidak penting / Because the period is unimportant
choice_d: Kerana zaman itu berlaku selepas tamadun awal / Because it happened after early civilisations
answer: Kerana tiada rekod bertulis ditinggalkan oleh manusia zaman itu / Because no written records were left by the people of that time

text: Apakah maksud Zaman Prasejarah? / What is the meaning of prehistory?
answer: Zaman Prasejarah ialah tempoh kehidupan manusia sebelum wujudnya sistem tulisan, dan dikaji melalui tinggalan seperti artifak dan fosil. / Prehistory is the period of human life before writing existed, studied through remains such as artifacts and fossils.

text: Senaraikan empat pembahagian Zaman Prasejarah. / List the four divisions of prehistory.
answer: Zaman Paleolitik, Zaman Mesolitik, Zaman Neolitik dan Zaman Logam. / The Palaeolithic, Mesolithic, Neolithic and Metal Ages.

text: Mengapakah arkeologi penting dalam kajian Zaman Prasejarah? / Why is archaeology important in studying prehistory?
answer: Kerana tiada rekod bertulis, arkeologi menyediakan bukti berbentuk artifak, fosil dan tapak kediaman untuk memahami kehidupan zaman itu. / Because there are no written records, archaeology supplies evidence in the form of artifacts, fossils and settlement sites to understand life then.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Topik ini menerangkan lokasi tapak prasejarah di dunia dan Asia Tenggara, termasuk bukti penemuan artifak dan ekofak.
text_en: This topic explains the locations of prehistoric sites in the world and Southeast Asia, including evidence of artifacts and ecofacts.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Tapak prasejarah dikesan melalui penemuan artifak dan ekofak di kawasan terbuka atau gua.
text_en: Prehistoric sites are identified through artifacts and ecofacts found in open areas or caves.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Contoh tapak dunia termasuk Altamira, Chauvet Cave, Catal Huyuk, Stonehenge, Bhimbetka, Zhoukoudian, Shahr-i-Sokhta, dan Gobekli Tepe.
text_en: Examples of world sites include Altamira, Chauvet Cave, Catal Huyuk, Stonehenge, Bhimbetka, Zhoukoudian, Shahr-i-Sokhta, and Gobekli Tepe.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Contoh tapak di Asia Tenggara termasuk Lenggong, Ban Chiang, Liang Bua Cave, Padah-lin Cave, Sa Hyun, dan Tabon Cave.
text_en: Examples in Southeast Asia include Lenggong, Ban Chiang, Liang Bua Cave, Padah-lin Cave, Sa Hyun, and Tabon Cave.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Penemuan tapak prasejarah membantu ahli arkeologi memahami petempatan, penguburan, dan peralatan masyarakat awal.
text_en: Discoveries of prehistoric sites help archaeologists understand settlements, burials, and the tools of early societies.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Tapak-tapak ini menjadi bukti penting tentang kehidupan manusia sebelum kemunculan tulisan.
text_en: These sites are important evidence of human life before the advent of writing.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Tapak prasejarah terkenal di dunia termasuk Olduvai Gorge di Afrika dan Lascaux di Perancis.
text_en: Famous prehistoric sites in the world include Olduvai Gorge in Africa and Lascaux in France.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Di Asia Tenggara, tapak penting termasuk Gua Niah di Sarawak dan Trinil di Jawa, Indonesia.
text_en: In Southeast Asia, important sites include Niah Cave in Sarawak and Trinil in Java, Indonesia.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Beliau menemui fosil Manusia Jawa (Homo erectus) di Trinil, Jawa pada tahun 1891. Penemuan ini membuktikan manusia awal pernah mendiami Asia Tenggara sejak ratusan ribu tahun dahulu.
text_en: He discovered the Java Man (Homo erectus) fossil at Trinil, Java in 1891. The find proved early humans inhabited Southeast Asia hundreds of thousands of years ago.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Fosil Manusia Jawa ditemui di / The Java Man fossil was found at
choice_a: Trinil, Jawa
choice_b: Gua Niah, Sarawak
choice_c: Lembah Lenggong, Perak
choice_d: Olduvai Gorge, Tanzania
answer: Trinil, Jawa

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Gua Niah terletak di negeri / Niah Cave is located in the state of
choice_a: Sarawak
choice_b: Sabah
choice_c: Perak
choice_d: Kelantan
answer: Sarawak

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Lukisan gua terkenal di Lascaux terletak di negara / The famous cave paintings at Lascaux are in
choice_a: Perancis / France
choice_b: Sepanyol / Spain
choice_c: Itali / Italy
choice_d: Jerman / Germany
answer: Perancis / France

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Mengapakah manusia prasejarah memilih kawasan berhampiran sungai dan gua? / Why did prehistoric humans choose areas near rivers and caves?
choice_a: Kerana terdapat sumber air, makanan dan tempat perlindungan / Because there was water, food and shelter
choice_b: Kerana kawasan itu mudah dipertahankan daripada tentera / Because such areas were easy to defend from armies
choice_c: Kerana tanah di situ sesuai untuk membina bandar / Because the land was suitable for building cities
choice_d: Kerana kawasan itu mempunyai bijih logam / Because those areas had metal ore
answer: Kerana terdapat sumber air, makanan dan tempat perlindungan / Because there was water, food and shelter

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Penemuan di Olduvai Gorge, Afrika penting kerana / Finds at Olduvai Gorge, Africa are important because
choice_a: Ia mengandungi tinggalan manusia awal dan alat batu tertua / They contain early human remains and some of the oldest stone tools
choice_b: Ia mengandungi tulisan purba / They contain ancient writing
choice_c: Ia merupakan bandar terawal dunia / It was the world's earliest city
choice_d: Ia menyimpan kuburan diraja / It holds royal tombs
answer: Ia mengandungi tinggalan manusia awal dan alat batu tertua / They contain early human remains and some of the oldest stone tools

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Namakan dua tapak prasejarah di Asia Tenggara. / Name two prehistoric sites in Southeast Asia.
answer: Gua Niah di Sarawak, Malaysia dan Trinil di Jawa, Indonesia. / Niah Cave in Sarawak, Malaysia and Trinil in Java, Indonesia.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Mengapakah gua sering dipilih sebagai tapak kediaman prasejarah? / Why were caves often chosen as prehistoric dwelling sites?
answer: Gua memberi perlindungan daripada cuaca dan binatang buas, dan biasanya terletak berhampiran sumber air serta makanan. / Caves offered protection from weather and wild animals and were usually near sources of water and food.

topic: 3.2 Lokasi Zaman Prasejarah di Dunia dan Asia Tenggara
text: Nyatakan kepentingan penemuan Eugene Dubois di Trinil. / State the significance of Eugene Dubois's discovery at Trinil.
answer: Penemuan fosil Homo erectus itu membuktikan manusia awal pernah mendiami Asia Tenggara dan menyokong kajian evolusi manusia. / The Homo erectus fossil proved early humans lived in Southeast Asia and supported research into human evolution.

text: Topik ini menerangkan ciri kehidupan manusia prasejarah dari segi kediaman, ekonomi, kepercayaan, dan kesenian.
text_en: This topic explains the characteristics of prehistoric human life in terms of dwellings, economy, beliefs, and art.

text: Kediaman manusia berubah daripada gua dan ranting kepada rumah tetap batu atau kayu.
text_en: Human dwellings changed from caves and branches to permanent stone or wooden houses.

text: Ekonomi berubah daripada sara diri dan nomad kepada pertanian, penternakan, dan sistem barter.
text_en: Economies shifted from subsistence and nomadic life to agriculture, animal husbandry, and barter systems.

text: Kepercayaan berkembang daripada animisme kepada ritual, penyembahan alam, dan kepercayaan kepada kehidupan selepas mati.
text_en: Beliefs evolved from animism to rituals, nature worship, and belief in life after death.

text: Seni pula berkembang daripada lukisan gua realistik kepada corak simbolik dan geometri pada tembikar serta gendang gangsa.
text_en: Art evolved from realistic cave paintings to symbolic and geometric designs on pottery and bronze drums.

text: Organisasi sosial mula menjadi lebih teratur dengan pembahagian peranan dan kelas.
text_en: Social organization became more structured with role and class divisions.

text: Zaman Paleolitik: manusia hidup nomad, memburu dan menggunakan alat batu kasar.
text_en: Palaeolithic: humans were nomadic, hunted, and used rough stone tools.

text: Zaman Neolitik: manusia mula menetap, bercucuk tanam, menternak binatang dan menghasilkan tembikar.
text_en: Neolithic: humans began to settle, farm, domesticate animals and make pottery.

text: Beliau menjumpai tapak kaki Laetoli dan pelbagai alat batu di Afrika Timur yang menunjukkan cara hidup manusia awal. Kajian beliau memberi gambaran jelas tentang pemburuan, pergerakan dan penggunaan alat manusia prasejarah.
text_en: She discovered the Laetoli footprints and many stone tools in East Africa that reveal how early humans lived. Her work gives a clear picture of prehistoric hunting, movement and tool use.

text: Ciri utama kehidupan Zaman Paleolitik ialah / The main feature of Palaeolithic life was
choice_a: Hidup nomad dan bergantung kepada memburu serta memungut / Nomadic life dependent on hunting and gathering
choice_b: Menetap dan bercucuk tanam / Settled farming
choice_c: Berdagang dengan wilayah jauh / Trading with distant regions
choice_d: Menggunakan alat besi / Using iron tools
answer: Hidup nomad dan bergantung kepada memburu serta memungut / Nomadic life dependent on hunting and gathering

text: Perubahan terbesar pada Zaman Neolitik ialah / The biggest change in the Neolithic was
choice_a: Manusia mula menetap dan bercucuk tanam / Humans began to settle and farm
choice_b: Manusia mula menggunakan api / Humans began to use fire
choice_c: Manusia mula tinggal di gua / Humans began living in caves
choice_d: Manusia mula berburu haiwan besar / Humans began hunting large animals
answer: Manusia mula menetap dan bercucuk tanam / Humans began to settle and farm

text: Tembikar mula dihasilkan secara meluas pada / Pottery began to be widely produced during the
choice_a: Zaman Neolitik / Neolithic
choice_b: Zaman Paleolitik / Palaeolithic
choice_c: Zaman Air Batu Awal / Early Ice Age
choice_d: Zaman Logam sahaja / Metal Age only
answer: Zaman Neolitik / Neolithic

text: Alat batu pada Zaman Paleolitik berbeza daripada Zaman Neolitik kerana / Palaeolithic stone tools differ from Neolithic tools because
choice_a: Alat Paleolitik kasar manakala alat Neolitik dicanai licin / Palaeolithic tools were rough while Neolithic tools were polished
choice_b: Alat Paleolitik diperbuat daripada logam / Palaeolithic tools were made of metal
choice_c: Alat Neolitik lebih besar dan berat / Neolithic tools were larger and heavier
choice_d: Alat Neolitik hanya digunakan untuk upacara / Neolithic tools were used only in ceremonies
answer: Alat Paleolitik kasar manakala alat Neolitik dicanai licin / Palaeolithic tools were rough while Neolithic tools were polished

text: Kepercayaan animisme pada zaman prasejarah dibuktikan melalui / Animist beliefs in prehistory are shown by
choice_a: Amalan pengebumian dengan barang kubur / Burial practices with grave goods
choice_b: Catatan undang-undang bertulis / Written legal records
choice_c: Pembinaan kuil batu besar di Asia Tenggara / Large stone temples in Southeast Asia
choice_d: Penggunaan mata wang / The use of coins
answer: Amalan pengebumian dengan barang kubur / Burial practices with grave goods

text: Bandingkan cara hidup manusia Zaman Paleolitik dan Zaman Neolitik. / Compare the way of life in the Palaeolithic and Neolithic.
answer: Manusia Paleolitik hidup nomad dengan memburu dan memungut makanan, manakala manusia Neolitik menetap, bercucuk tanam dan menternak binatang. / Palaeolithic people were nomadic hunter-gatherers, while Neolithic people settled, farmed and kept animals.

text: Nyatakan dua bukti bahawa manusia prasejarah mempunyai kepercayaan. / State two pieces of evidence that prehistoric humans held beliefs.
