answer: Amalan mengebumikan mayat bersama barang kubur dan lukisan gua yang mungkin berkaitan upacara atau pemburuan. / Burials accompanied by grave goods, and cave paintings possibly linked to rituals or hunting.

text: Jelaskan kepentingan penciptaan alat batu kepada manusia prasejarah. / Explain the importance of stone tools to prehistoric humans.
answer: Alat batu membolehkan mereka memburu, memotong daging, menyiang kulit dan mempertahankan diri, lalu meningkatkan peluang hidup. / Stone tools let them hunt, cut meat, process hides and defend themselves, improving their chances of survival.

text: Topik ini menerangkan bagaimana aktiviti prasejarah diteruskan dan dipertingkat dalam masyarakat moden hari ini.
text_en: This topic explains how prehistoric activities continued and improved in modern society today.

text: Aktiviti pertanian dan penternakan berkembang daripada sara diri kepada industri komersial besar-besaran.
text_en: Agriculture and livestock activities evolved from subsistence to large-scale commercial industries.

text: Aktiviti memburu binatang berubah daripada keperluan hidup kepada hobi berlesen.
text_en: Animal hunting changed from a survival necessity to a licensed hobby.

text: Peralatan dan tembikar berkembang daripada batu dan tulang kepada mesin moden dan industri penting.
text_en: Tools and pottery evolved from stone and bone to modern machinery and important industries.

text: Amalan menghormati orang mati dan seni bina megalitik terus memberi inspirasi kepada masyarakat moden.
text_en: Practices of honoring the dead and megalithic architecture continue to inspire modern societies.

text: Sumbangan prasejarah masih dapat dilihat dalam kehidupan seharian moden.
text_en: Prehistoric contributions are still visible in everyday modern life.

text: Pertanian yang bermula pada Zaman Neolitik menjadi asas kepada kehidupan menetap dan pembentukan tamadun.
text_en: Farming that began in the Neolithic became the basis for settled life and the formation of civilisations.

text: Kemahiran membuat tembikar, menenun dan mencipta alat diwarisi dan diperhalusi oleh masyarakat kemudian.
text_en: Skills in pottery, weaving and toolmaking were inherited and refined by later societies.

text: Beliau mengkaji tapak Jarmo di Iraq dan menunjukkan bagaimana manusia mula menjinakkan tumbuhan dan haiwan. Kajian beliau menjelaskan peralihan daripada memburu kepada pertanian yang menjadi asas tamadun.
text_en: He excavated Jarmo in Iraq and showed how humans first domesticated plants and animals. His work explains the shift from hunting to farming that laid the foundation of civilisation.

text: Sumbangan terbesar Zaman Neolitik kepada tamadun kemudian ialah / The greatest Neolithic contribution to later civilisation was
choice_a: Amalan pertanian dan kehidupan menetap / Farming and settled life
choice_b: Penciptaan mata wang / The invention of currency
choice_c: Pembinaan jalan raya berturap / The building of paved roads
choice_d: Penciptaan sistem tulisan / The invention of writing
answer: Amalan pertanian dan kehidupan menetap / Farming and settled life

text: Penjinakan haiwan penting kerana ia menyediakan / Animal domestication was important because it provided
choice_a: Sumber makanan, tenaga kerja dan bahan pakaian yang berterusan / A steady source of food, labour and clothing material
choice_b: Bahan untuk membuat logam / Material for making metal
choice_c: Hiburan kepada golongan bangsawan / Entertainment for nobles
choice_d: Alat pengangkutan laut / Sea transport
answer: Sumber makanan, tenaga kerja dan bahan pakaian yang berterusan / A steady source of food, labour and clothing material

text: Kemahiran prasejarah yang diwarisi sehingga kini termasuk / Prehistoric skills inherited to this day include
choice_a: Membuat tembikar dan menenun / Pottery making and weaving
choice_b: Mencetak buku / Book printing
choice_c: Membina kapal wap / Building steamships
choice_d: Membuat kaca optik / Making optical glass
answer: Membuat tembikar dan menenun / Pottery making and weaving

text: Lebihan hasil pertanian membolehkan masyarakat awal / Surplus farm produce allowed early societies to
choice_a: Membentuk pembahagian kerja dan kumpulan pakar / Develop division of labour and specialist groups
choice_b: Berhenti bekerja sepenuhnya / Stop working entirely
choice_c: Meninggalkan kampung mereka / Abandon their villages
choice_d: Menghentikan perdagangan / End all trade
answer: Membentuk pembahagian kerja dan kumpulan pakar / Develop division of labour and specialist groups

text: Kesinambungan zaman prasejarah bermaksud / Continuity from prehistory means
choice_a: Amalan dan kemahiran zaman itu diteruskan serta diperbaik oleh generasi kemudian / Practices and skills of that era were continued and improved by later generations
choice_b: Zaman itu berulang semula hari ini / That era repeats itself today
choice_c: Tiada perubahan berlaku sejak zaman itu / No change has occurred since then
choice_d: Semua tinggalan zaman itu telah hilang / All remains of that era have vanished
answer: Amalan dan kemahiran zaman itu diteruskan serta diperbaik oleh generasi kemudian / Practices and skills of that era were continued and improved by later generations

text: Nyatakan dua sumbangan Zaman Neolitik kepada kehidupan hari ini. / State two Neolithic contributions to life today.
answer: Amalan bercucuk tanam dan menternak haiwan yang menjadi asas pengeluaran makanan, serta kemahiran membuat tembikar dan menenun. / Farming and animal husbandry, which underpin food production, and skills in pottery and weaving.

text: Bagaimanakah pertanian membawa kepada pembentukan tamadun? / How did farming lead to the formation of civilisations?
answer: Pertanian menghasilkan lebihan makanan yang membolehkan penduduk menetap, bertambah ramai dan membentuk pembahagian kerja serta organisasi sosial. / Farming produced surplus food, allowing people to settle, grow in number and develop division of labour and social organisation.

text: Jelaskan maksud kesinambungan dalam konteks Zaman Prasejarah. / Explain the meaning of continuity in the context of prehistory.
answer: Kesinambungan bermaksud kemahiran, kepercayaan dan amalan zaman prasejarah tidak terhenti tetapi diwarisi dan diperhalusi oleh masyarakat kemudian. / Continuity means prehistoric skills, beliefs and practices did not stop but were inherited and refined by later societies.

text: Topik ini menerangkan perkembangan zaman prasejarah di Malaysia dari Paleolitik hingga Logam, beserta bukti arkeologi yang ditemui.
text_en: This topic explains the development of the prehistoric age in Malaysia from the Palaeolithic to the Metal Age, along with archaeological evidence found.

text: Malaysia meliputi Zaman Paleolitik, Hoabinhian/Epi-Paleolitik, Neolitik, dan Logam.
text_en: Malaysia covered the Palaeolithic, Hoabinhian/Epi-Palaeolithic, Neolithic, and Metal Ages.

text: Bukti kewujudan prasejarah di Malaysia termasuk peralatan batu dan logam, tembikar, manik, lukisan gua, ukiran batu, dan budaya megalit.
text_en: Evidence of prehistoric life in Malaysia includes stone and metal tools, pottery, beads, cave paintings, stone carvings, and megalithic culture.

text: Contoh tapak penting termasuk Kota Tampan, Gua Niah, Tingkayu, Gua Cha, Jenderam Hilir, Gua Kecil, Lubang Angin, Lembah Bernam, dan Sungai Tembeling.
text_en: Important sites include Kota Tampan, Niah Cave, Tingkayu, Gua Cha, Jenderam Hilir, Gua Kecil, Lubang Angin, Bernam Valley, and Sungai Tembeling.

text: Kaedah pengebumian prasejarah di Malaysia termasuk pengebumian memanjang, melentur, keranda kayu, tempayan, dan kubur kepingan batu.
text_en: Burial methods included extended burial, flexed burial, wooden coffins, jar burial, and stone-slab graves.

text: Penemuan di Malaysia menunjukkan masyarakat prasejarah sudah mempunyai kemampuan ekonomi, sosial, dan kepercayaan yang kompleks.
text_en: Findings in Malaysia show prehistoric communities already had complex economic, social, and belief systems.

text: Lembah Lenggong di Perak ialah tapak prasejarah penting dan diiktiraf sebagai Tapak Warisan Dunia UNESCO pada tahun 2012.
text_en: The Lenggong Valley in Perak is an important prehistoric site, recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2012.

text: Perak Man ialah rangka manusia prasejarah paling lengkap yang ditemui di Asia Tenggara, berusia kira-kira 11 000 tahun.
text_en: Perak Man is the most complete prehistoric human skeleton found in Southeast Asia, about 11,000 years old.

text: Beliau mengetuai penemuan Perak Man di Gua Gunung Runtuh, Lenggong pada tahun 1991 dan menjalankan kajian meluas di Lembah Lenggong. Sumbangan beliau menjadikan Lenggong diiktiraf sebagai Tapak Warisan Dunia UNESCO.
text_en: She led the discovery of Perak Man at Gua Gunung Runtuh, Lenggong in 1991 and carried out extensive research in the Lenggong Valley. Her work led to Lenggong's recognition as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

text: Perak Man ditemui di / Perak Man was found at
choice_a: Gua Gunung Runtuh, Lenggong
choice_b: Gua Niah, Sarawak
choice_c: Gua Cha, Kelantan
choice_d: Bukit Tengkorak, Sabah
answer: Gua Gunung Runtuh, Lenggong

text: Lembah Lenggong diiktiraf sebagai Tapak Warisan Dunia UNESCO pada tahun / The Lenggong Valley was recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in
Tapak Bukit Tengkorak di Sabah terkenal sebagai / Bukit Tengkorak in Sabah is known as
choice_a: Pusat pembuatan tembikar prasejarah terbesar di Asia Tenggara / The largest prehistoric pottery-making centre in Southeast Asia
choice_b: Tapak penemuan alat besi tertua / The oldest iron tool site
choice_c: Kubur diraja Melayu awal / An early Malay royal tomb
choice_d: Bandar pelabuhan purba / An ancient port city
answer: Pusat pembuatan tembikar prasejarah terbesar di Asia Tenggara / The largest prehistoric pottery-making centre in Southeast Asia

text: Penemuan di Gua Niah, Sarawak penting kerana / Finds at Niah Cave, Sarawak are important because
choice_a: Tengkorak manusia berusia puluhan ribu tahun ditemui di situ / A human skull tens of thousands of years old was found there
choice_b: Terdapat tulisan purba pada dindingnya / Ancient writing was found on its walls
choice_c: Ia merupakan kilang logam purba / It was an ancient metal foundry
choice_d: Ia menjadi pusat perdagangan India / It was an Indian trading centre
answer: Tengkorak manusia berusia puluhan ribu tahun ditemui di situ / A human skull tens of thousands of years old was found there

text: Bukti Zaman Logam di Malaysia termasuk penemuan / Evidence of the Metal Age in Malaysia includes finds of
choice_a: Gendang gangsa dan alat besi / Bronze drums and iron tools
choice_b: Mata wang emas Rom / Roman gold coins
choice_c: Papirus bertulis / Written papyrus
choice_d: Kereta kuda purba / Ancient chariots
answer: Gendang gangsa dan alat besi / Bronze drums and iron tools

text: Nyatakan kepentingan Lembah Lenggong dalam sejarah Malaysia. / State the importance of the Lenggong Valley in Malaysian history.
answer: Lembah Lenggong menyimpan bukti kehidupan prasejarah yang berterusan termasuk Perak Man, dan diiktiraf sebagai Tapak Warisan Dunia UNESCO pada tahun 2012. / The Lenggong Valley holds evidence of continuous prehistoric life including Perak Man and was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2012.

text: Siapakah Perak Man dan mengapakah penemuannya penting? / Who is Perak Man and why is the discovery important?
answer: Perak Man ialah rangka manusia prasejarah berusia kira-kira 11 000 tahun yang paling lengkap ditemui di Asia Tenggara, memberi maklumat tentang fizikal dan amalan pengebumian zaman itu. / Perak Man is the most complete prehistoric skeleton found in Southeast Asia, about 11,000 years old, revealing physical traits and burial practices of the time.

text: Namakan dua tapak prasejarah lain di Malaysia dan kepentingannya. / Name two other prehistoric sites in Malaysia and their significance.
answer: Gua Niah di Sarawak yang menyimpan tinggalan manusia awal, dan Bukit Tengkorak di Sabah yang menjadi pusat pembuatan tembikar prasejarah. / Niah Cave in Sarawak, holding early human remains, and Bukit Tengkorak in Sabah, a prehistoric pottery-making centre.

text: Topik ini menerangkan maksud tamadun dari sudut bahasa Yunani, Arab, Inggeris, dan Melayu, serta hubungannya dengan kemajuan masyarakat.
text_en: This topic explains the meaning of civilisation from Greek, Arabic, English, and Malay perspectives, as well as its relationship to societal progress.

text: Perkataan civitas dalam bahasa Yunani membawa maksud bandar atau kota.
text_en: The word civitas in Greek means town or city.

text: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, civilisation merujuk kepada peringkat perkembangan manusia dan organisasi yang dianggap maju.
text_en: In English, civilisation refers to the level of human and organizational development regarded as advanced.

text: Dalam bahasa Arab, istilah seperti mudun, madain, madana, hadharah, dan hadari berkaitan dengan bandar, kekayaan, dan kehidupan yang tersusun.
text_en: In Arabic, terms such as mudun, madain, madana, hadharah, and hadari are related to cities, wealth, and organized life.

text: Dalam bahasa Melayu, tamadun sering dikaitkan dengan perkataan peradaban yang merujuk kepada kemajuan dalam kebendaan dan pemikiran.
text_en: In Malay, civilisation is often associated with the word peradaban, meaning progress in material life and thought.

text: Tamadun melibatkan perkembangan budaya, sains, industri, ekonomi, dan sistem kerajaan.
text_en: Civilisation involves the development of culture, science, industry, economy, and government systems.

text: Perkataan tamadun berasal daripada perkataan Arab 'mudun' atau 'madain' yang bermaksud kota atau bandar.
text_en: The word 'tamadun' comes from the Arabic 'mudun' or 'madain', meaning city or town.

text: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, tamadun disebut 'civilisation' yang berasal daripada perkataan Latin 'civitas' bermaksud kota.
text_en: In English, 'civilisation' derives from the Latin 'civitas', meaning city.

text: Beliau menjelaskan tamadun sebagai keadaan kehidupan bermasyarakat yang tinggi berasaskan akhlak dan adab. Pandangan beliau menekankan nilai moral, bukan sekadar pembangunan kebendaan.
text_en: He described civilisation as a high state of communal life grounded in moral character and courtesy. His view stresses moral values rather than material development alone.

text: Perkataan 'tamadun' berasal daripada bahasa Arab yang bermaksud / The word 'tamadun' comes from an Arabic word meaning
choice_a: Kota atau bandar / City or town
choice_b: Sungai besar / Great river
choice_c: Raja yang adil / A just king
choice_d: Tulisan purba / Ancient writing
answer: Kota atau bandar / City or town

text: Perkataan 'civilisation' berasal daripada perkataan Latin / The word 'civilisation' derives from the Latin
choice_a: Civitas
choice_b: Cultura
choice_c: Historia
choice_d: Imperium
answer: Civitas

text: Secara umum, tamadun bermaksud / Generally, civilisation means
choice_a: Pencapaian tinggi masyarakat dalam kehidupan bandar, budaya dan nilai / A society's high achievement in urban life, culture and values
choice_b: Kumpulan manusia yang hidup nomad / A group of humans living nomadically
choice_c: Kawasan yang mempunyai banyak gunung / An area with many mountains
choice_d: Kumpulan yang tidak mempunyai pemerintah / A group without rulers
answer: Pencapaian tinggi masyarakat dalam kehidupan bandar, budaya dan nilai / A society's high achievement in urban life, culture and values

text: Menurut Syed Muhammad Naquib al-Attas, asas tamadun ialah / According to Syed Muhammad Naquib al-Attas, the basis of civilisation is
choice_a: Akhlak dan adab dalam kehidupan bermasyarakat / Moral character and courtesy in communal life
choice_b: Kekuatan tentera / Military strength
choice_c: Kekayaan emas dan perak / Wealth in gold and silver
choice_d: Jumlah penduduk yang ramai / A large population
answer: Akhlak dan adab dalam kehidupan bermasyarakat / Moral character and courtesy in communal life

text: Kemunculan tamadun biasanya dikaitkan dengan / The rise of civilisation is usually linked to
choice_a: Kehidupan menetap di kawasan lembah sungai yang subur / Settled life in fertile river valleys
choice_b: Kehidupan nomad di padang pasir / Nomadic life in deserts
choice_c: Kehidupan di kawasan berais / Life in icy regions
choice_d: Kehidupan di puncak gunung tinggi / Life on high mountain peaks
answer: Kehidupan menetap di kawasan lembah sungai yang subur / Settled life in fertile river valleys

text: Nyatakan asal usul perkataan tamadun dan maksudnya. / State the origin of the word 'tamadun' and its meaning.
answer: Perkataan tamadun berasal daripada perkataan Arab 'mudun' atau 'madain' yang bermaksud kota, merujuk kepada kehidupan bandar yang teratur. / It comes from the Arabic 'mudun' or 'madain', meaning city, referring to organised urban life.

text: Jelaskan perbezaan penekanan antara konsep tamadun Islam dan Barat. / Explain the difference in emphasis between Islamic and Western concepts of civilisation.
answer: Konsep Islam menekankan akhlak, adab dan nilai rohani di samping kemajuan kebendaan, manakala konsep Barat lebih menekankan kemajuan kebendaan, bandar dan teknologi. / The Islamic concept stresses morals, courtesy and spiritual values alongside material progress, while the Western concept emphasises material, urban and technological advancement.

text: Mengapakah kawasan lembah sungai menjadi tempat lahirnya tamadun awal? / Why did river valleys become the birthplace of early civilisations?
answer: Tanah di lembah sungai subur dan bekalan air berterusan membolehkan pertanian menghasilkan lebihan makanan untuk menampung penduduk yang ramai. / River valley soil is fertile and water is constant, so farming produced surplus food to support large populations.

text: Topik ini membandingkan konsep tamadun menurut pandangan Islam dan Barat, termasuk fokus pembangunan lahiriah dan rohaniah.
text_en: This topic compares the concept of civilisation according to Islamic and Western views, including focus on physical and spiritual development.

text: Pandangan Islam membina tamadun atas asas Islam sebagai al-Din, iaitu cara hidup.
text_en: The Islamic view builds civilisation on the basis of Islam as al-Din, a way of life.

text: Pandangan Islam menekankan keseimbangan perkembangan lahiriah dan rohaniah berdasarkan al-Quran dan Hadis.
text_en: The Islamic view emphasizes a balance between physical and spiritual development based on the Quran and Hadith.

text: Ibn Khaldun memperkenalkan istilah umran dan hadharah dalam Muqaddimah.
text_en: Ibn Khaldun introduced the terms umran and hadharah in Muqaddimah.

text: Hadharah merangkumi akidah, undang-undang, akhlak, falsafah, dan budaya, manakala madaniyyah merujuk kepada aspek kebendaan.
text_en: Hadharah covers faith, law, morals, philosophy, and culture, while madaniyyah refers to material aspects.

text: Pandangan Barat lebih menekankan pembangunan lahiriah, kebendaan, sains, teknologi, ekonomi, dan pembandaran.
text_en: The Western view places more emphasis on physical and material development, science, technology, economics, and urbanization.

text: Konsep tamadun Islam merangkumi pembangunan kebendaan dan kerohanian secara seimbang.
text_en: The Islamic concept of civilisation covers material and spiritual development in balance.

text: Konsep tamadun Barat lebih menumpukan kemajuan bandar, teknologi, undang-undang dan pencapaian material.
text_en: The Western concept focuses more on urban growth, technology, law and material achievement.

text: Beliau memperkenalkan konsep 'umran' iaitu pembangunan kehidupan bermasyarakat, dan 'hadharah' iaitu kehidupan bandar yang maju. Beliau turut menerangkan kitaran kebangkitan dan kejatuhan sesebuah tamadun melalui semangat 'asabiyyah'.
text_en: He introduced 'umran', the development of communal life, and 'hadharah', advanced urban life. He also explained the cycle of a civilisation's rise and fall through the spirit of 'asabiyyah'.

text: Beliau mentakrifkan tamadun sebagai sistem masyarakat yang memperkasakan bidang politik, ekonomi, sosial dan seni. Beliau berpendapat tamadun berkembang melalui tindak balas terhadap cabaran alam dan manusia.
text_en: He defined civilisation as a social system that strengthens politics, economy, society and the arts. He held that civilisations grow by responding to natural and human challenges.

text: Konsep 'hadharah' dalam pemikiran Ibn Khaldun merujuk kepada / The concept 'hadharah' in Ibn Khaldun's thought refers to
choice_a: Kehidupan bandar yang maju / Advanced urban life
choice_b: Kehidupan nomad di padang pasir / Nomadic desert life
choice_c: Sistem tulisan Arab / The Arabic writing system
choice_d: Undang-undang perang / The laws of war
answer: Kehidupan bandar yang maju / Advanced urban life

text: Menurut Toynbee, tamadun berkembang apabila masyarakat / According to Toynbee, civilisations grow when a society
choice_a: Memberi tindak balas yang berjaya terhadap cabaran / Responds successfully to challenges
choice_b: Mengelakkan semua perubahan / Avoids all change
choice_c: Menakluki negara jiran / Conquers neighbouring countries
choice_d: Mengumpulkan kekayaan sahaja / Merely accumulates wealth
answer: Memberi tindak balas yang berjaya terhadap cabaran / Responds successfully to challenges

text: Perbezaan utama konsep tamadun Islam dan Barat ialah / The main difference between Islamic and Western concepts of civilisation is
choice_a: Islam menekankan kerohanian dan akhlak bersama kemajuan material / Islam stresses spirituality and morals alongside material progress
choice_b: Barat menolak sepenuhnya pembangunan bandar / The West rejects urban development entirely
choice_c: Islam menolak kemajuan sains / Islam rejects scientific progress
choice_d: Barat tidak mempunyai sistem undang-undang / The West has no legal system
answer: Islam menekankan kerohanian dan akhlak bersama kemajuan material / Islam stresses spirituality and morals alongside material progress

text: Semangat 'asabiyyah' yang disebut Ibn Khaldun bermaksud / The 'asabiyyah' spirit mentioned by Ibn Khaldun means
choice_a: Semangat kekitaan dan perpaduan kumpulan / Group solidarity and a sense of belonging
choice_b: Semangat berperang tanpa sebab / A desire to fight without reason
choice_c: Kepercayaan kepada nasib / Belief in fate
choice_d: Cinta kepada kemewahan / Love of luxury
answer: Semangat kekitaan dan perpaduan kumpulan / Group solidarity and a sense of belonging

text: Persamaan konsep tamadun Islam dan Barat ialah kedua-duanya mengaitkan tamadun dengan / A similarity between the Islamic and Western concepts is that both link civilisation with
choice_a: Kehidupan bermasyarakat yang tersusun dan maju / Organised and advanced communal life
choice_b: Kehidupan berpindah randah / A nomadic way of life
choice_c: Penolakan terhadap ilmu / Rejection of knowledge
choice_d: Pemerintahan tanpa undang-undang / Rule without law
answer: Kehidupan bermasyarakat yang tersusun dan maju / Organised and advanced communal life

text: Jelaskan konsep 'umran' dan 'hadharah' yang diperkenalkan oleh Ibn Khaldun. / Explain the concepts 'umran' and 'hadharah' introduced by Ibn Khaldun.
answer: 'Umran' merujuk kepada pembangunan kehidupan bermasyarakat secara keseluruhan, manakala 'hadharah' merujuk kepada kehidupan bandar yang maju dan berbudaya tinggi. / 'Umran' refers to the overall development of communal life, while 'hadharah' refers to advanced, culturally rich urban life.

text: Nyatakan takrifan tamadun menurut Arnold J. Toynbee. / State Arnold J. Toynbee's definition of civilisation.
answer: Toynbee mentakrifkan tamadun sebagai sistem masyarakat yang memperkasakan bidang politik, ekonomi, sosial dan seni. / Toynbee defined civilisation as a social system that strengthens politics, economy, society and the arts.

text: Mengapakah penting mempelajari konsep tamadun daripada pelbagai pandangan? / Why is it important to study the concept of civilisation from various viewpoints?
answer: Pelbagai pandangan memberikan gambaran yang lebih lengkap dan mengelakkan penilaian berat sebelah terhadap pencapaian sesebuah masyarakat. / Multiple viewpoints give a fuller picture and prevent a one-sided judgement of a society's achievements.

text: Topik ini menerangkan ciri-ciri tamadun awal dunia seperti pertanian, perdagangan, sistem pemerintahan, pembentukan bandar, pengkhususan pekerjaan, teknologi, organisasi sosial, agama, tulisan, dan kesenian.
text_en: This topic explains the characteristics of early world civilisations such as agriculture, trade, government systems, urban formation, job specialization, technology, social organisation, religion, writing, and art.

text: Pertanian dan perdagangan menjadi asas perkembangan tamadun awal.
text_en: Agriculture and trade became the foundation of early civilisations.

text: Sistem pemerintahan berkembang daripada pendeta kepada raja dan undang-undang.
text_en: Government systems evolved from priests to kings and laws.

text: Kampung berkembang menjadi bandar yang tersusun dengan kubu dan kuil.
text_en: Villages developed into organized cities with forts and temples.

text: Pekerjaan menjadi lebih khusus seperti pemungut cukai, askar, jurutera, petani, dan tukang.
text_en: Jobs became more specialized such as tax collectors, soldiers, engineers, farmers, and artisans.

text: Teknologi seperti monumen, metalurgi, roda, dan bajak memajukan tamadun awal.
text_en: Technologies such as monuments, metallurgy, wheels, and plows advanced early civilisations.

text: Organisasi sosial menjadi lebih hierarki dengan golongan pemerintah, tukang, petani, dan hamba.
text_en: Social organization became more hierarchical with rulers, artisans, farmers, and slaves.

text: Agama dan kepercayaan memainkan peranan penting dalam kehidupan masyarakat.
text_en: Religion and belief played an important role in people's lives.

text: Tulisan seperti piktograf dan kuneiform membantu menyimpan rekod.
text_en: Writing systems such as pictographs and cuneiform helped preserve records.

text: Kesenian dan kesusasteraan memperkukuh identiti dan budaya masyarakat.
text_en: Art and literature strengthened identity and culture.

text: Antara ciri tamadun ialah petempatan kekal, organisasi sosial, sistem pemerintahan, agama, bahasa dan tulisan.
text_en: Features of civilisation include permanent settlement, social organisation, government, religion, language and writing.

text: Sistem tulisan membolehkan urusan pentadbiran, perdagangan dan keagamaan direkodkan dengan tepat.
text_en: Writing systems allowed administrative, trade and religious matters to be recorded accurately.

text: Beliau memperkenalkan idea 'revolusi bandar' dan menyenaraikan ciri-ciri yang membezakan bandar awal daripada kampung. Senarai ciri seperti petempatan kekal, pengkhususan kerja dan tulisan masih digunakan untuk mengenal pasti tamadun.
text_en: He introduced the idea of the 'urban revolution' and listed the features that distinguish early cities from villages. His criteria, such as permanent settlement, specialised work and writing, are still used to identify civilisations.

text: Antara berikut, yang manakah ciri utama sebuah tamadun? / Which of the following is a main feature of a civilisation?
choice_a: Petempatan kekal dan sistem pemerintahan / Permanent settlement and a system of government
choice_b: Kehidupan berpindah randah / A nomadic way of life
choice_c: Ketiadaan pembahagian kerja / Absence of division of labour
choice_d: Ketiadaan kepercayaan agama / Absence of religious belief
answer: Petempatan kekal dan sistem pemerintahan / Permanent settlement and a system of government

text: Pengkhususan kerja dalam tamadun awal bermaksud / Specialisation of labour in early civilisations means
choice_a: Penduduk melakukan pekerjaan berbeza mengikut kemahiran / People did different jobs according to their skills
choice_b: Semua penduduk bertani sahaja / Everyone farmed only
choice_c: Penduduk tidak perlu bekerja / People did not need to work
choice_d: Kerja ditentukan oleh cuaca / Work was decided by the weather
answer: Penduduk melakukan pekerjaan berbeza mengikut kemahiran / People did different jobs according to their skills

text: Kepentingan sistem tulisan kepada tamadun awal ialah / The importance of writing to early civilisations was that it
choice_a: Membolehkan rekod pentadbiran, perdagangan dan ilmu disimpan / Allowed administrative, trade and knowledge records to be kept
choice_b: Menghalang perdagangan dengan wilayah lain / Prevented trade with other regions
choice_c: Menggantikan keperluan kepada pemerintah / Replaced the need for rulers
choice_d: Menyebabkan penduduk berpindah randah / Caused people to become nomadic
answer: Membolehkan rekod pentadbiran, perdagangan dan ilmu disimpan / Allowed administrative, trade and knowledge records to be kept

text: Organisasi sosial dalam tamadun awal biasanya berbentuk / Social organisation in early civilisations was usually
choice_a: Susun lapis masyarakat daripada pemerintah hingga rakyat biasa / A hierarchy from rulers down to commoners
choice_b: Semua orang mempunyai kedudukan yang sama / Everyone held equal rank
choice_c: Tiada ketua dalam masyarakat / No leaders in society
choice_d: Dipilih melalui undian umum / Chosen by general election
answer: Susun lapis masyarakat daripada pemerintah hingga rakyat biasa / A hierarchy from rulers down to commoners

text: Agama dalam tamadun awal berperanan untuk / Religion in early civilisations served to
choice_a: Menyatukan masyarakat dan mengesahkan kuasa pemerintah / Unite society and legitimise the ruler's authority
choice_b: Menghalang pembinaan bandar / Prevent city building
choice_c: Menggantikan sistem tulisan / Replace the writing system
choice_d: Menamatkan aktiviti perdagangan / End trading activity
answer: Menyatukan masyarakat dan mengesahkan kuasa pemerintah / Unite society and legitimise the ruler's authority

text: Senaraikan empat ciri tamadun awal dunia. / List four features of early world civilisations.
answer: Petempatan kekal, organisasi sosial berlapis, sistem pemerintahan dan undang-undang, serta bahasa dan sistem tulisan. / Permanent settlement, a layered social organisation, a system of government and law, and language with a writing system.

text: Jelaskan kepentingan sistem tulisan dalam tamadun awal. / Explain the importance of writing in early civilisations.
answer: Tulisan membolehkan undang-undang, urusan cukai, perdagangan dan ilmu direkod serta diwariskan dengan tepat kepada generasi seterusnya. / Writing allowed laws, taxation, trade and knowledge to be recorded and passed accurately to later generations.

text: Mengapakah pengkhususan kerja penting kepada perkembangan tamadun? / Why was specialisation of labour important to the growth of civilisation?
answer: Pengkhususan membolehkan kemahiran diperhalusi dalam bidang tertentu seperti seni, pembinaan dan pentadbiran, lalu mempercepat kemajuan masyarakat. / Specialisation allowed skills to be refined in fields such as art, construction and administration, speeding up social progress.

text: Topik ini menerangkan empat tamadun awal dunia yang berkembang di lembah sungai serta kepentingan sungai kepada masyarakatnya.
text_en: This topic explains four early world civilisations that developed in river valleys and the importance of rivers to their communities.

text: Tamadun Mesopotamia berkembang di antara Sungai Tigris dan Sungai Euphrates.
text_en: Mesopotamian Civilisation developed between the Tigris and Euphrates Rivers.

text: Tamadun Mesir Purba berkembang di Lembah Sungai Nil.
text_en: Ancient Egyptian Civilisation developed in the Nile River Valley.

text: Tamadun Indus berkembang di Lembah Sungai Indus.
text_en: Indus Civilisation developed in the Indus River Valley.

text: Tamadun Huang He berkembang di Lembah Sungai Huang He atau Sungai Kuning.
text_en: Huang He Civilisation developed in the Huang He, or Yellow River, Valley.

text: Sungai membekalkan air untuk pertanian dan kegunaan harian, di samping menjadi laluan perhubungan dan pengangkutan.
text_en: Rivers supplied water for agriculture and daily use, as well as routes for communication and transportation.

text: Empat tamadun awal dunia ialah Mesopotamia, Mesir Purba, Indus dan Hwang Ho.
text_en: The four early world civilisations are Mesopotamia, Ancient Egypt, the Indus and the Hwang Ho.

text: Kesemua tamadun ini muncul di lembah sungai yang subur dan menyediakan bekalan air sepanjang tahun.
text_en: All these civilisations arose in fertile river valleys that supplied water throughout the year.

text: Beliau mengetuai penggalian Mohenjo-Daro dan Harappa pada tahun 1920-an yang mendedahkan kewujudan Tamadun Indus. Penemuan itu menunjukkan wujudnya bandar terancang dengan sistem saliran yang teratur.
text_en: He led the excavation of Mohenjo-Daro and Harappa in the 1920s, revealing the Indus Civilisation. The finds showed well-planned cities with organised drainage systems.

text: Tamadun Mesopotamia terletak di antara dua sungai iaitu / Mesopotamian civilisation lay between two rivers, namely
choice_a: Sungai Tigris dan Euphrates / The Tigris and Euphrates
choice_b: Sungai Nil dan Indus / The Nile and Indus
choice_c: Sungai Hwang Ho dan Yangtze / The Hwang Ho and Yangtze
choice_d: Sungai Ganges dan Mekong / The Ganges and Mekong
answer: Sungai Tigris dan Euphrates / The Tigris and Euphrates

text: Tamadun Mesir Purba berkembang di sepanjang / Ancient Egyptian civilisation developed along the
choice_a: Sungai Nil / Nile
choice_b: Sungai Indus / Indus
choice_c: Sungai Tigris / Tigris
choice_d: Sungai Hwang Ho / Hwang Ho
answer: Sungai Nil / Nile

text: Bandar utama Tamadun Indus ialah / The main cities of the Indus Civilisation were
choice_a: Mohenjo-Daro dan Harappa
choice_b: Ur dan Babylon
choice_c: Memphis dan Thebes
choice_d: Anyang dan Luoyang
answer: Mohenjo-Daro dan Harappa

text: Tamadun Hwang Ho berkembang di negara / The Hwang Ho civilisation developed in
choice_a: China
choice_b: India
choice_c: Iraq
choice_d: Mesir / Egypt
answer: China

text: Mengapakah keempat-empat tamadun awal muncul di lembah sungai? / Why did all four early civilisations arise in river valleys?
choice_a: Tanah subur dan bekalan air memudahkan pertanian dan pengangkutan / Fertile soil and water supply eased farming and transport
choice_b: Kawasan itu selamat daripada semua serangan / Such areas were safe from all attack
choice_c: Kawasan itu mempunyai banyak bijih logam / Those areas had abundant metal ore
choice_d: Kawasan itu sejuk sepanjang tahun / Those areas were cool all year
answer: Tanah subur dan bekalan air memudahkan pertanian dan pengangkutan / Fertile soil and water supply eased farming and transport

text: Namakan empat tamadun awal dunia dan sungai masing-masing. / Name the four early civilisations and their rivers.
answer: Mesopotamia (Tigris dan Euphrates), Mesir Purba (Nil), Indus (Indus) dan Hwang Ho (Hwang Ho). / Mesopotamia (Tigris and Euphrates), Ancient Egypt (Nile), Indus (Indus) and Hwang Ho (Hwang Ho).

text: Jelaskan mengapa lembah sungai sesuai untuk kemunculan tamadun. / Explain why river valleys were suitable for the rise of civilisations.
answer: Banjir bermusim menyuburkan tanah dan air sungai membolehkan pengairan serta pengangkutan, menghasilkan lebihan makanan untuk penduduk yang ramai. / Seasonal floods enriched the soil and river water allowed irrigation and transport, producing surplus food for large populations.

text: Nyatakan satu ciri istimewa bandar Tamadun Indus. / State one special feature of Indus Civilisation cities.
answer: Bandar seperti Mohenjo-Daro dirancang secara teratur dengan jalan bersilang tepat dan sistem saliran bawah tanah. / Cities such as Mohenjo-Daro were laid out in an orderly grid with underground drainage systems.

text: Topik ini menerangkan perkembangan Tamadun Mesopotamia, Mesir Purba, Indus dan Huang He.
text_en: This topic explains the development of the Mesopotamian, Ancient Egyptian, Indus, and Huang He Civilisations.

text: Tamadun Mesopotamia bermula di Sumeria, kawasan Bulan Sabit Subur, dan terkenal dengan negara-kota seperti Ur serta zigurat.
text_en: Mesopotamian Civilisation began in Sumer in the Fertile Crescent and was known for city-states such as Ur and ziggurats.

text: Tamadun Mesir Purba dikenali sebagai Hadiah Sungai Nil dan melalui zaman Kerajaan Purba, Pertengahan, dan Baru.
text_en: Ancient Egyptian Civilisation was known as the Gift of the Nile and passed through the Old, Middle, and New Kingdom periods.

text: Tamadun Indus mempunyai bandar terancang Mohenjo-Daro dan Harappa dengan sistem perpaipan dan pembetungan yang canggih.
text_en: Indus Civilisation had the planned cities of Mohenjo-Daro and Harappa, with sophisticated plumbing and sewerage systems.

text: Tamadun Huang He berkembang di utara China melalui kerajaan Xia, Shang, dan Zhou.
text_en: Huang He Civilisation developed in northern China through the Xia, Shang, and Zhou dynasties.

text: Anyang menjadi salah satu pusat penting dalam perkembangan Tamadun Huang He.
text_en: Anyang was one important centre in the development of Huang He Civilisation.

text: Tamadun Mesopotamia memperkenalkan tulisan cuneiform dan sistem bandar negeri seperti Ur dan Babylon.
text_en: Mesopotamia introduced cuneiform writing and city-states such as Ur and Babylon.

text: Tamadun Mesir Purba diperintah oleh Firaun yang dianggap sebagai raja dan wakil tuhan.
text_en: Ancient Egypt was ruled by Pharaohs, regarded as kings and representatives of the gods.

text: Beliau menyatukan wilayah Mesopotamia dan memperkenalkan Kod Undang-undang Hammurabi yang diukir pada tiang batu. Kod ini merupakan antara undang-undang bertulis terawal dunia yang mengatur perdagangan, keluarga dan hukuman.
text_en: He unified Mesopotamia and introduced the Code of Hammurabi, carved on a stone pillar. It is among the world's earliest written legal codes, governing trade, family matters and punishment.

text: Sistem tulisan Tamadun Mesopotamia dikenali sebagai / The writing system of Mesopotamia is known as
choice_a: Cuneiform
choice_b: Hieroglif / Hieroglyphics
choice_c: Tulisan oracle / Oracle bone script
choice_d: Sanskrit
answer: Cuneiform

text: Kod Undang-undang Hammurabi penting kerana ia / The Code of Hammurabi is important because it
choice_a: Merupakan antara undang-undang bertulis terawal di dunia / Is among the earliest written law codes in the world
choice_b: Merupakan kitab agama pertama / Was the first religious scripture
choice_c: Mengajar cara membina piramid / Taught how to build pyramids
choice_d: Merupakan buku perubatan pertama / Was the first medical book
answer: Merupakan antara undang-undang bertulis terawal di dunia / Is among the earliest written law codes in the world

text: Pemerintah Tamadun Mesir Purba digelar / The ruler of Ancient Egypt was called
choice_a: Firaun / Pharaoh
choice_b: Maharaja / Emperor
choice_c: Sultan
choice_d: Raja Dinasti Shang / Shang king
answer: Firaun / Pharaoh

text: Sistem tulisan Mesir Purba ialah / The writing system of Ancient Egypt was
choice_a: Hieroglif / Hieroglyphics
choice_b: Cuneiform
choice_c: Alfabet Latin / The Latin alphabet
choice_d: Tulisan Brahmi / Brahmi script
answer: Hieroglif / Hieroglyphics

text: Dinasti awal dalam Tamadun Hwang Ho ialah / An early dynasty of the Hwang Ho civilisation was
choice_a: Dinasti Shang
choice_b: Dinasti Maurya
choice_c: Dinasti Ptolemy
choice_d: Dinasti Umayyah
answer: Dinasti Shang

text: Jelaskan kepentingan Kod Undang-undang Hammurabi. / Explain the importance of the Code of Hammurabi.
answer: Kod ini menetapkan peraturan bertulis tentang perdagangan, keluarga dan hukuman supaya keadilan dilaksanakan secara seragam di seluruh wilayah. / The code set out written rules on trade, family and punishment so that justice was applied uniformly across the realm.

text: Nyatakan dua sistem tulisan tamadun awal dan tamadun yang menggunakannya. / State two early writing systems and the civilisations that used them.
answer: Cuneiform digunakan oleh Tamadun Mesopotamia dan hieroglif digunakan oleh Tamadun Mesir Purba. / Cuneiform was used by Mesopotamia and hieroglyphics by Ancient Egypt.

text: Bagaimanakah sistem pemerintahan membantu perkembangan tamadun awal? / How did systems of government help early civilisations develop?
answer: Pemerintahan yang teratur membolehkan pengurusan pengairan, cukai, pertahanan dan projek pembinaan besar dilaksanakan secara tersusun. / Organised government allowed irrigation, taxation, defence and large building projects to be managed systematically.

text: Topik ini membandingkan sumbangan tamadun awal dalam pemerintahan, ekonomi, teknologi, kesenian dan binaan.
text_en: This topic compares contributions of early civilisations in government, economy, technology, arts, and architecture.

text: Tamadun Mesopotamia menyumbang Kod Hammurabi, tulisan kuneiform, roda, bajak, sauh, dan sistem nombor berasaskan 60.
text_en: Mesopotamian Civilisation contributed the Code of Hammurabi, cuneiform writing, the wheel, plough, anchor, and a base-60 number system.

text: Tamadun Mesir Purba diperintah oleh Firaun dan menghasilkan papirus, kalendar 365 hari, perubatan, piramid, serta Sfinks.
text_en: Ancient Egypt was ruled by Pharaohs and produced papyrus, a 365-day calendar, medicine, pyramids, and the Sphinx.

text: Tamadun Indus mempunyai pemerintahan oleh golongan pendeta, perkembangan pertanian dan perdagangan, serta tembikar dan ukiran batu.
text_en: Indus Civilisation was governed by priests and developed agriculture, trade, pottery, and stone carvings.

text: Tamadun Huang He memperkenalkan konsep Mandat dari Syurga, kompas magnetik, benang sutera, dan puisi.
text_en: Huang He Civilisation introduced the Mandate of Heaven, magnetic compass, silk thread, and poetry.

text: Sumbangan tamadun awal menjadi asas perkembangan pentadbiran, ekonomi, teknologi, dan kebudayaan dunia.
text_en: Early civilisations' contributions formed foundations for world administration, economy, technology, and culture.

text: Mesopotamia menyumbang roda, sistem nombor asas 60 dan kalendar berdasarkan bulan.
text_en: Mesopotamia contributed the wheel, a base-60 number system and a lunar calendar.

text: Mesir Purba menyumbang kalendar 365 hari, ilmu perubatan dan teknik pembinaan piramid.
text_en: Ancient Egypt contributed the 365-day calendar, medical knowledge and pyramid-building techniques.

text: Beliau merancang Piramid Berperingkat Djoser di Saqqara, iaitu binaan batu besar terawal di dunia. Beliau juga dihormati sebagai tabib dan menunjukkan gabungan ilmu seni bina serta perubatan dalam tamadun Mesir.
text_en: He designed the Step Pyramid of Djoser at Saqqara, the world's earliest large stone structure. He was also revered as a physician, showing how architecture and medicine combined in Egyptian civilisation.

text: Sistem nombor asas 60 yang masih digunakan untuk mengira masa berasal daripada / The base-60 number system still used to measure time came from
choice_a: Tamadun Mesopotamia
choice_b: Tamadun Mesir Purba
choice_c: Tamadun Indus
choice_d: Tamadun Hwang Ho
answer: Tamadun Mesopotamia

text: Kalendar 365 hari diperkenalkan oleh Tamadun / The 365-day calendar was introduced by the civilisation of
choice_a: Mesir Purba / Ancient Egypt
choice_b: Indus
choice_c: Hwang Ho
choice_d: Mesopotamia
answer: Mesir Purba / Ancient Egypt

text: Sumbangan istimewa Tamadun Indus ialah / A distinctive contribution of the Indus Civilisation was
choice_a: Perancangan bandar dan sistem saliran teratur / City planning and organised drainage
choice_b: Penciptaan roda / The invention of the wheel
choice_c: Pembinaan piramid / Pyramid building
choice_d: Tulisan cuneiform / Cuneiform writing
answer: Perancangan bandar dan sistem saliran teratur / City planning and organised drainage

text: Sumbangan Tamadun Hwang Ho termasuk / Contributions of the Hwang Ho civilisation include
choice_a: Tulisan pada tulang oracle dan kemahiran tembaga / Oracle bone writing and bronze working
choice_b: Kod undang-undang Hammurabi / The Code of Hammurabi
choice_c: Piramid Giza / The Pyramids of Giza
choice_d: Sistem tulisan hieroglif / Hieroglyphic writing
answer: Tulisan pada tulang oracle dan kemahiran tembaga / Oracle bone writing and bronze working

text: Persamaan sumbangan keempat-empat tamadun awal ialah kesemuanya / A shared contribution of all four early civilisations is that each
choice_a: Mencipta sistem tulisan dan pentadbiran sendiri / Created its own writing and administrative system
choice_b: Membina piramid batu / Built stone pyramids
choice_c: Menggunakan mata wang kertas / Used paper currency
choice_d: Mengamalkan sistem demokrasi / Practised democracy
answer: Mencipta sistem tulisan dan pentadbiran sendiri / Created its own writing and administrative system

text: Nyatakan dua sumbangan Tamadun Mesopotamia kepada dunia hari ini. / State two Mesopotamian contributions to the world today.
answer: Penciptaan roda yang mengubah pengangkutan, dan sistem nombor asas 60 yang masih digunakan untuk mengira masa dan sudut. / The invention of the wheel, which transformed transport, and the base-60 number system still used for time and angles.

text: Bandingkan sumbangan Tamadun Mesir Purba dan Tamadun Indus. / Compare the contributions of Ancient Egypt and the Indus Civilisation.
answer: Mesir Purba terkenal dengan kalendar, perubatan dan pembinaan piramid, manakala Indus terkenal dengan bandar terancang dan sistem saliran yang teratur. / Ancient Egypt is known for its calendar, medicine and pyramids, while the Indus is known for planned cities and organised drainage.

text: Mengapakah sumbangan tamadun awal masih relevan hari ini? / Why are the contributions of early civilisations still relevant today?
answer: Asas seperti tulisan, undang-undang, kalendar, bandar terancang dan sistem nombor masih digunakan dan diperkembang dalam kehidupan moden. / Foundations such as writing, law, calendars, planned cities and number systems are still used and developed in modern life.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Topik ini menerangkan lokasi, polis dan ciri utama Tamadun Yunani.
text_en: This topic explains the location, polis, and main features of Greek Civilisation.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Tamadun Yunani berkembang di Semenanjung Greece dan pulau-pulau di Laut Aegean serta Laut Mediterranean antara 1000 SM hingga 800 SM.
text_en: Greek Civilisation developed on the Greek Peninsula and islands in the Aegean and Mediterranean Seas between 1000 BC and 800 BC.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Negara-kota Yunani dikenali sebagai polis dan terdiri daripada bandar utama, bandar kecil, serta kawasan kampung.
text_en: Greek city-states were known as polis and consisted of a main town, small towns, and countryside villages.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Acropolis ialah pusat komuniti berkubu di lokasi strategik, manakala Agora ialah kawasan lapang untuk pertemuan dan pasar awam.
text_en: The Acropolis was a fortified community centre in a strategic location, while the Agora was an open meeting and marketplace area.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Athens mempunyai penduduk paling ramai, Sparta paling luas, dan Corinth juga merupakan polis terkenal.
text_en: Athens had the largest population, Sparta was the largest in area, and Corinth was also a famous polis.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Tamadun Yunani terletak di Semenanjung Balkan yang bergunung-ganang dan dikelilingi Laut Mediterranean serta Laut Aegean.
text_en: Greek civilisation lay on the mountainous Balkan Peninsula, surrounded by the Mediterranean and Aegean Seas.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Keadaan geografi yang berbukit menyebabkan terbentuknya bandar negeri (polis) yang bebas seperti Athens dan Sparta.
text_en: The hilly terrain led to the formation of independent city-states (polis) such as Athens and Sparta.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Beliau dikaitkan dengan epik Iliad dan Odyssey yang menceritakan Perang Troy dan pengembaraan Odysseus. Karya ini menjadi sumber penting tentang kepercayaan, nilai dan masyarakat Yunani awal.
text_en: He is associated with the epics Iliad and Odyssey, telling of the Trojan War and Odysseus's voyage. These works are a key source on early Greek beliefs, values and society.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Tamadun Yunani terletak di / Greek civilisation was located on the
choice_a: Semenanjung Balkan / Balkan Peninsula
choice_b: Semenanjung Itali / Italian Peninsula
choice_c: Lembah Sungai Nil / Nile Valley
choice_d: Semenanjung Arab / Arabian Peninsula
answer: Semenanjung Balkan / Balkan Peninsula

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Bandar negeri dalam tamadun Yunani dikenali sebagai / A city-state in Greek civilisation was known as
choice_a: Polis
choice_b: Forum
choice_c: Agora
choice_d: Senat
answer: Polis

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Keadaan bergunung-ganang di Yunani menyebabkan / The mountainous terrain of Greece resulted in
choice_a: Terbentuknya bandar negeri yang bebas dan berasingan / The rise of separate, independent city-states
choice_b: Terbentuknya satu empayar bersatu sejak awal / A single unified empire from the start
choice_c: Ketiadaan aktiviti perdagangan / The absence of trade
choice_d: Penduduk hidup secara nomad / A nomadic population
answer: Terbentuknya bandar negeri yang bebas dan berasingan / The rise of separate, independent city-states

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Dua bandar negeri Yunani yang terkenal ialah / Two famous Greek city-states were
choice_a: Athens dan Sparta
choice_b: Ur dan Babylon
choice_c: Rom dan Carthage
choice_d: Memphis dan Thebes
answer: Athens dan Sparta

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Epik Iliad dan Odyssey penting sebagai / The epics Iliad and Odyssey are important as
choice_a: Sumber tentang kepercayaan dan nilai masyarakat Yunani awal / A source on early Greek beliefs and values
choice_b: Kod undang-undang bertulis Yunani / The written legal code of Greece
choice_c: Rekod cukai bandar negeri / Tax records of the city-states
choice_d: Peta pelayaran Mediterranean / Navigation charts of the Mediterranean
answer: Sumber tentang kepercayaan dan nilai masyarakat Yunani awal / A source on early Greek beliefs and values

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Jelaskan bagaimana kedudukan geografi mempengaruhi perkembangan Tamadun Yunani. / Explain how geography influenced the development of Greek civilisation.
answer: Kawasan bergunung memisahkan penduduk sehingga terbentuk bandar negeri yang bebas, manakala kedudukan berhampiran laut menggalakkan pelayaran dan perdagangan. / Mountains separated communities so independent city-states formed, while the coastal position encouraged seafaring and trade.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Apakah maksud polis dalam tamadun Yunani? / What does 'polis' mean in Greek civilisation?
answer: Polis ialah bandar negeri yang mentadbir wilayahnya sendiri dengan pemerintahan, tentera dan undang-undang tersendiri. / A polis was a city-state that governed its own territory with its own government, army and laws.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Nyatakan kepentingan karya Homer kepada kajian sejarah Yunani. / State the importance of Homer's works to the study of Greek history.
answer: Karya Homer memberi gambaran tentang kepercayaan, nilai wira dan susunan masyarakat Yunani awal yang sukar diperoleh daripada sumber lain. / Homer's works reveal early Greek beliefs, heroic values and social order that are hard to obtain from other sources.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Topik ini menerangkan perkembangan sistem pemerintahan Athens dan Sparta.
text_en: This topic explains the development of government systems in Athens and Sparta.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Athens melalui sistem Monarki, Oligarki, Aristokrasi, Tirani, dan Demokrasi.
text_en: Athens experienced Monarchy, Oligarchy, Aristocracy, Tyranny, and Democracy.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Demokrasi Athens melibatkan Dewan Perhimpunan, Majlis 500, Majistret, dan Juri.
text_en: Athenian democracy involved the Assembly, Council of 500, Magistrates, and Juries.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Pericles memantapkan demokrasi dengan menekankan kuasa rakyat.
text_en: Pericles strengthened democracy by emphasizing the power of citizens.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Sparta mengamalkan monarki terhad yang dipimpin dua raja serta menekankan disiplin ketenteraan dan latihan fizikal.
text_en: Sparta practised a limited monarchy led by two kings and emphasized military discipline and physical training.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Athens mengamalkan sistem demokrasi yang membenarkan warganegara lelaki dewasa menyertai perhimpunan (ecclesia).
text_en: Athens practised a democracy allowing adult male citizens to take part in the assembly (ecclesia).

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Sparta mengamalkan sistem oligarki dan menumpukan latihan ketenteraan yang ketat kepada rakyatnya.
text_en: Sparta practised oligarchy and focused on rigorous military training for its people.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Beliau memperkukuh amalan demokrasi Athens dengan membenarkan lebih ramai warganegara memegang jawatan awam dan menerima bayaran. Zaman pemerintahannya dikenali sebagai Zaman Kegemilangan Athens dengan pembinaan Parthenon.
text_en: He strengthened Athenian democracy by allowing more citizens to hold public office with payment. His era is known as the Golden Age of Athens, marked by the building of the Parthenon.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Sistem pemerintahan yang diamalkan di Athens ialah / The system of government practised in Athens was
choice_a: Demokrasi / Democracy
choice_b: Oligarki / Oligarchy
choice_c: Monarki mutlak / Absolute monarchy
choice_d: Teokrasi / Theocracy
answer: Demokrasi / Democracy

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Perhimpunan warganegara Athens dikenali sebagai / The assembly of Athenian citizens was known as
choice_a: Ecclesia
choice_b: Senat / Senate
choice_c: Polis
choice_d: Agora
answer: Ecclesia

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Sparta terkenal dengan / Sparta was renowned for
choice_a: Latihan ketenteraan yang ketat / Rigorous military training
choice_b: Sistem demokrasi terbuka / An open democratic system
choice_c: Perdagangan antarabangsa yang luas / Extensive international trade
choice_d: Pembinaan piramid / Pyramid building
answer: Latihan ketenteraan yang ketat / Rigorous military training

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Zaman Kegemilangan Athens dikaitkan dengan pemerintahan / The Golden Age of Athens is associated with the leadership of
choice_a: Pericles
choice_b: Hammurabi
choice_c: Julius Caesar
choice_d: Asoka
answer: Pericles

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Kelemahan demokrasi Athens ialah / A weakness of Athenian democracy was that
choice_a: Hanya warganegara lelaki dewasa boleh mengundi / Only adult male citizens could vote
choice_b: Tiada perhimpunan diadakan / No assembly was held
choice_c: Rakyat tidak dibenarkan bersuara langsung / Citizens could not speak at all
choice_d: Jawatan awam diwarisi sepenuhnya / Public offices were entirely hereditary
answer: Hanya warganegara lelaki dewasa boleh mengundi / Only adult male citizens could vote

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Bandingkan sistem pemerintahan Athens dan Sparta. / Compare the systems of government in Athens and Sparta.
answer: Athens mengamalkan demokrasi dengan penyertaan warganegara dalam perhimpunan, manakala Sparta mengamalkan oligarki yang dikuasai golongan kecil dan menekankan ketenteraan. / Athens practised democracy with citizen participation in an assembly, while Sparta practised oligarchy dominated by a small group with a military focus.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Jelaskan sumbangan Pericles kepada demokrasi Athens. / Explain Pericles's contribution to Athenian democracy.
answer: Beliau membuka jawatan awam kepada lebih ramai warganegara dan memperkenalkan bayaran bagi jawatan itu supaya golongan biasa juga boleh berkhidmat. / He opened public office to more citizens and introduced payment for those posts so ordinary people could also serve.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.2 Peningkatan Pemerintahan dan Pentadbiran Tamadun Yunani
text: Nyatakan satu kelemahan sistem demokrasi Athens. / State one weakness of Athenian democracy.
answer: Hak mengundi terhad kepada warganegara lelaki dewasa sahaja, manakala wanita, hamba dan orang asing tidak dibenarkan menyertainya. / Voting rights were limited to adult male citizens, while women, slaves and foreigners were excluded.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Topik ini menerangkan lokasi, zaman perkembangan, Pax Romana dan struktur masyarakat Tamadun Rom.
text_en: This topic explains the location, historical eras, Pax Romana, and social structure of Roman Civilisation.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Tamadun Rom terletak di Lembah Latium berhampiran Sungai Tiber.
text_en: Roman Civilisation was located in the Latium Valley near the Tiber River.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Tiga zaman utama Rom ialah Zaman Beraja, Zaman Republik, dan Zaman Empayar.
text_en: The three main Roman eras were the Monarchy, Republic, and Empire eras.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Pax Romana berlangsung dari 27 SM hingga 180 M dan membawa keamanan selama 200 tahun di Asia, Afrika, dan Eropah.
text_en: Pax Romana lasted from 27 BC to AD 180 and brought 200 years of peace across Asia, Africa, and Europe.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Masyarakat Rom terdiri daripada Patrician, Plebian seperti petani, artisan dan peniaga, serta hamba.
text_en: Roman society consisted of Patricians, Plebeians such as farmers, artisans, and traders, and slaves.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Tamadun Rom bermula di Semenanjung Itali di sepanjang Sungai Tiber dan berkembang menjadi empayar yang luas.
text_en: Roman civilisation began on the Italian Peninsula along the Tiber River and grew into a vast empire.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Rom berkembang daripada sistem republik kepada sistem empayar yang diperintah oleh maharaja.
text_en: Rome developed from a republic into an empire ruled by emperors.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Beliau menamatkan zaman republik dan menjadi maharaja pertama Rom pada tahun 27 SM. Pemerintahannya memulakan Pax Romana, iaitu tempoh keamanan panjang yang membolehkan perdagangan dan pembinaan berkembang pesat.
text_en: He ended the republic and became Rome's first emperor in 27 BC. His reign began the Pax Romana, a long peace that let trade and construction flourish.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Tamadun Rom bermula di sepanjang sungai / Roman civilisation began along the river
choice_a: Tiber
choice_b: Nil / Nile
choice_c: Euphrates
choice_d: Danube
answer: Tiber

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Maharaja pertama Rom ialah / The first Roman emperor was
choice_a: Augustus
choice_b: Julius Caesar
choice_c: Pericles
choice_d: Hannibal
answer: Augustus

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Pax Romana bermaksud / Pax Romana means
choice_a: Tempoh keamanan panjang dalam Empayar Rom / A long period of peace in the Roman Empire
choice_b: Undang-undang perang Rom / Roman laws of war
choice_c: Dewan perhimpunan rakyat Rom / The Roman popular assembly
choice_d: Sistem cukai Rom / The Roman tax system
answer: Tempoh keamanan panjang dalam Empayar Rom / A long period of peace in the Roman Empire

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Sebelum menjadi empayar, Rom mengamalkan sistem / Before becoming an empire, Rome practised a system of
choice_a: Republik / Republic
choice_b: Demokrasi langsung / Direct democracy
choice_c: Teokrasi / Theocracy
choice_d: Feudalisme / Feudalism
answer: Republik / Republic

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Undang-undang Rom penting kerana ia / Roman law is important because it
choice_a: Menjadi asas sistem perundangan banyak negara hari ini / Became the basis of many modern legal systems
choice_b: Digunakan hanya untuk golongan bangsawan / Applied only to nobles
choice_c: Melarang perdagangan antara wilayah / Forbade inter-regional trade
choice_d: Menggantikan sistem tulisan Latin / Replaced the Latin script
answer: Menjadi asas sistem perundangan banyak negara hari ini / Became the basis of many modern legal systems

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Jelaskan perubahan sistem pemerintahan Rom daripada republik kepada empayar. / Explain Rome's change from a republic to an empire.
answer: Kuasa yang dikongsi oleh Senat dan pegawai pilihan beralih kepada seorang pemimpin tunggal apabila Augustus menjadi maharaja pertama pada tahun 27 SM. / Power shared by the Senate and elected officials passed to a single ruler when Augustus became the first emperor in 27 BC.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Apakah maksud Pax Romana dan kesannya? / What was the Pax Romana and its effect?
answer: Pax Romana ialah tempoh keamanan panjang dalam Empayar Rom yang membolehkan perdagangan, pembinaan jalan dan perkembangan bandar berlaku dengan pesat. / The Pax Romana was a long peace in the Roman Empire that allowed trade, road building and urban growth to flourish.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
text: Nyatakan satu sumbangan Tamadun Rom yang masih digunakan hari ini. / State one Roman contribution still used today.
answer: Sistem undang-undang Rom menjadi asas kepada perundangan moden, termasuk prinsip keadilan dan hak individu. / Roman law became the foundation of modern legal systems, including principles of justice and individual rights.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Topik ini menerangkan ciri dan kegunaan binaan utama Tamadun Rom.
text_en: This topic explains the features and uses of major Roman architectural works.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Seni bina Rom terkenal dengan ketahanan, saiz besar, nilai estetika, kubah, arca, dan penggunaan simen pozzolana.
text_en: Roman architecture was known for durability, large scale, aesthetic value, domes, arches, and the use of pozzolana concrete.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Marco Vitruvius ialah arkitek Rom terkenal yang mengarang buku On Architecture.
text_en: Marco Vitruvius was a famous Roman architect who wrote On Architecture.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Colosseum digunakan untuk pertandingan gladiator dan boleh memuatkan kira-kira 50,000 orang, manakala Pantheon ialah tempat penyembahan dewa-dewi.
text_en: The Colosseum hosted gladiator contests and seated about 50,000 people, while the Pantheon was a temple for worshipping gods.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Akueduk membekalkan air ke bandar dan tempat mandi, jalan raya berlapis digunakan untuk tentera dan pengangkutan, manakala tembok mempertahankan empayar.
text_en: Aqueducts supplied water to cities and baths, layered roads supported military movement and transport, and walls defended the empire.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Rom memperkenalkan penggunaan konkrit, gerbang dan kubah yang membolehkan binaan besar dan kukuh didirikan.
text_en: Rome introduced concrete, arches and domes that allowed large, sturdy structures to be built.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Akueduk dibina untuk mengalirkan air bersih dari pergunungan ke bandar-bandar Rom.
text_en: Aqueducts were built to carry clean water from the mountains into Roman cities.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Beliau menulis 'De Architectura' yang menggariskan tiga prinsip seni bina iaitu kekukuhan, kegunaan dan keindahan. Panduan beliau mempengaruhi reka bentuk bangunan di Eropah selama berabad-abad.
text_en: He wrote 'De Architectura', setting out three principles of architecture: strength, utility and beauty. His guidance influenced European building design for centuries.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Bahan binaan penting yang diperkenalkan oleh Rom ialah / An important building material introduced by Rome was
choice_a: Konkrit / Concrete
choice_b: Kaca tebal / Thick glass
choice_c: Keluli / Steel
choice_d: Simen putih moden / Modern white cement
answer: Konkrit / Concrete

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Colosseum di Rom digunakan sebagai / The Colosseum in Rome was used as
choice_a: Tempat pertunjukan dan pertandingan gladiator / A venue for shows and gladiator contests
choice_b: Istana maharaja / The emperor's palace
choice_c: Dewan Senat / The Senate house
choice_d: Gudang bijirin / A grain warehouse
answer: Tempat pertunjukan dan pertandingan gladiator / A venue for shows and gladiator contests

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Akueduk Rom berfungsi untuk / Roman aqueducts functioned to
choice_a: Mengalirkan air bersih ke bandar / Carry clean water into cities
choice_b: Menghubungkan dua benua / Connect two continents
choice_c: Menyimpan hasil pertanian / Store farm produce
choice_d: Menahan serangan tentera / Repel military attacks
answer: Mengalirkan air bersih ke bandar / Carry clean water into cities

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Tiga prinsip seni bina menurut Vitruvius ialah / Vitruvius's three principles of architecture were
choice_a: Kekukuhan, kegunaan dan keindahan / Strength, utility and beauty
choice_b: Kelajuan, kos dan saiz / Speed, cost and size
choice_c: Warna, bunyi dan cahaya / Colour, sound and light
choice_d: Ketinggian, keluasan dan kedalaman / Height, width and depth
answer: Kekukuhan, kegunaan dan keindahan / Strength, utility and beauty

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Gerbang dan kubah penting dalam seni bina Rom kerana / Arches and domes were important in Roman architecture because they
choice_a: Membolehkan bangunan besar menampung berat dengan lebih baik / Allowed large buildings to bear weight better
choice_b: Menjimatkan penggunaan air / Saved water
choice_c: Memudahkan bangunan dirobohkan / Made buildings easy to demolish
choice_d: Menghalang cahaya matahari sepenuhnya / Blocked sunlight completely
answer: Membolehkan bangunan besar menampung berat dengan lebih baik / Allowed large buildings to bear weight better

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Nyatakan dua ciri seni bina Tamadun Rom. / State two features of Roman architecture.
answer: Penggunaan gerbang dan kubah untuk menampung beban, serta penggunaan konkrit yang membolehkan binaan besar seperti Colosseum dan Pantheon. / The use of arches and domes to bear loads, and of concrete which made large structures such as the Colosseum and Pantheon possible.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Jelaskan kepentingan akueduk kepada masyarakat Rom. / Explain the importance of aqueducts to Roman society.
answer: Akueduk membekalkan air bersih dari pergunungan ke bandar untuk kegunaan harian, tempat mandi awam dan kebersihan, lalu meningkatkan kesihatan penduduk. / Aqueducts supplied clean mountain water to cities for daily use, public baths and sanitation, improving public health.

chapter: Bab 6: Peningkatan Tamadun Yunani dan Rom
topic: 6.4 Peningkatan Seni Bina dalam Tamadun Rom
text: Bagaimanakah seni bina Rom mempengaruhi bangunan moden? / How has Roman architecture influenced modern buildings?
answer: Ciri seperti gerbang, kubah, tiang dan penggunaan konkrit masih digunakan dalam bangunan kerajaan, stadium dan tempat awam hari ini. / Features such as arches, domes, columns and concrete are still used in government buildings, stadiums and public spaces today.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Topik ini menerangkan perluasan kuasa secara fizikal dan keagamaan dalam Tamadun India.
text_en: This topic explains physical and religious expansion of power in Indian Civilisation.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Perluasan kuasa ialah usaha kerajaan atau raja untuk menguasai dan memperluas pengaruh di sesebuah kawasan.
text_en: Expansion of power is the effort of a kingdom or ruler to control and expand influence in a region.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Faktor perluasan kuasa termasuk kekuatan ketenteraan, dasar pemerintahan, sumber manusia, diplomasi keagamaan, dan kewangan.
text_en: Factors of expansion include military strength, government policy, human resources, religious diplomacy, and finance.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Dinasti Nanda, Maurya dan Gupta memperluas kuasa secara fizikal; Pataliputra menjadi pusat pemerintahan utama.
text_en: The Nanda, Maurya, and Gupta Dynasties expanded physically; Pataliputra was a main administrative centre.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Selepas Perang Kalinga, Maharaja Asoka menyebarkan agama Buddha melalui Tiang Asoka dan misi ke beberapa wilayah.
text_en: After the Kalinga War, Emperor Asoka spread Buddhism through the Pillars of Asoka and missions to several regions.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Zaman Gupta dikenali sebagai zaman keemasan agama Hindu, dan Raja Samudragupta digelar Kaviraja.
text_en: The Gupta Period was known as the golden age of Hinduism, and King Samudragupta was called Kaviraja.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Tamadun India berkembang daripada Tamadun Indus kepada zaman Vedik dan seterusnya Empayar Maurya serta Gupta.
text_en: Indian civilisation developed from the Indus Civilisation through the Vedic period to the Maurya and Gupta empires.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Sumbangan Tamadun India termasuk sistem nombor termasuk konsep sifar, dan angka yang menjadi asas angka moden.
text_en: Indian contributions include a number system with the concept of zero, the basis of modern numerals.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Selepas Perang Kalinga, beliau memeluk agama Buddha dan memerintah dengan prinsip aman serta kebajikan rakyat. Beliau mengukir titah pada tiang batu dan membina stupa, hospital serta jalan di seluruh empayar.
text_en: After the Kalinga War he embraced Buddhism and ruled on principles of peace and public welfare. He inscribed edicts on stone pillars and built stupas, hospitals and roads across the empire.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Empayar Maurya diperintah oleh maharaja terkenal iaitu / The Maurya Empire was ruled by the famous emperor
choice_a: Asoka
choice_b: Chandragupta II sahaja / Chandragupta II only
choice_c: Qin Shi Huang
choice_d: Darius
answer: Asoka

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Selepas Perang Kalinga, Asoka / After the Kalinga War, Asoka
choice_a: Memeluk agama Buddha dan memerintah secara aman / Embraced Buddhism and ruled peacefully
choice_b: Menakluki seluruh China / Conquered all of China
choice_c: Menghapuskan sistem pentadbiran / Abolished the administrative system
choice_d: Berpindah ke Parsi / Moved to Persia
answer: Memeluk agama Buddha dan memerintah secara aman / Embraced Buddhism and ruled peacefully

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Sumbangan matematik Tamadun India yang penting ialah / An important Indian mathematical contribution was
choice_a: Konsep sifar dan sistem angka / The concept of zero and the numeral system
choice_b: Sistem nombor asas 60 / The base-60 number system
choice_c: Kalendar 365 hari / The 365-day calendar
choice_d: Abakus / The abacus
answer: Konsep sifar dan sistem angka / The concept of zero and the numeral system

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Zaman Gupta sering digelar / The Gupta period is often called
choice_a: Zaman Kegemilangan Tamadun India / The Golden Age of Indian civilisation
choice_b: Zaman Kegelapan India / India's Dark Age
choice_c: Zaman Prasejarah India / India's prehistoric era
choice_d: Zaman Penjajahan India / India's colonial era
answer: Zaman Kegemilangan Tamadun India / The Golden Age of Indian civilisation

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Stupa dalam seni bina India berfungsi sebagai / A stupa in Indian architecture served as
choice_a: Binaan keagamaan Buddha untuk menyimpan peninggalan suci / A Buddhist religious structure housing sacred relics
choice_b: Kubu pertahanan tentera / A military fortress
choice_c: Pasar perdagangan utama / A main trading market
choice_d: Istana maharaja / An emperor's palace
answer: Binaan keagamaan Buddha untuk menyimpan peninggalan suci / A Buddhist religious structure housing sacred relics

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Nyatakan dua sumbangan Tamadun India kepada dunia. / State two contributions of Indian civilisation to the world.
answer: Sistem angka termasuk konsep sifar yang menjadi asas matematik moden, dan perkembangan agama Buddha serta Hindu yang tersebar ke Asia. / The numeral system including zero, the basis of modern mathematics, and the spread of Buddhism and Hinduism across Asia.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Jelaskan perubahan pemerintahan Asoka selepas Perang Kalinga. / Explain the change in Asoka's rule after the Kalinga War.
answer: Beliau berhenti berperang, memeluk agama Buddha dan menumpukan pemerintahan kepada kebajikan rakyat seperti membina hospital, jalan dan perigi. / He ceased warfare, embraced Buddhism and focused his rule on public welfare, building hospitals, roads and wells.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Bagaimanakah agama mempengaruhi seni bina Tamadun India? / How did religion influence Indian architecture?
answer: Kepercayaan Hindu dan Buddha melahirkan binaan seperti kuil dan stupa yang dihiasi ukiran bermotif keagamaan. / Hindu and Buddhist beliefs produced structures such as temples and stupas decorated with religious carvings.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Topik ini menerangkan perkembangan dinasti Qin dan Han, pendidikan, serta peperiksaan perkhidmatan awam Tamadun China.
text_en: This topic explains the Qin and Han Dynasties, education, and civil service examinations in Chinese Civilisation.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Tamadun China bermula di Lembah Sungai Huang He.
text_en: Chinese Civilisation began in the Huang He River Valley.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Maharaja Shi Huangdi daripada Dinasti Qin menyatukan China, menyeragamkan tulisan serta unit timbang dan sukat, dan membina Tembok Besar.
text_en: Emperor Shi Huangdi of the Qin Dynasty unified China, standardized writing, weights and measures, and built the Great Wall.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Dinasti Han diasaskan oleh Liu Bang; zaman Maharaja Han Wu Di menyaksikan pembukaan Laluan Sutera dan pelaksanaan peperiksaan awam.
text_en: The Han Dynasty was founded by Liu Bang; Emperor Han Wu Di's reign saw the opening of the Silk Road and civil service examinations.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Pendidikan merangkumi peringkat rendah, menengah dan tinggi serta berasaskan teks suci dan ajaran Konfusianisme.
text_en: Education included primary, secondary, and higher levels and was based on sacred texts and Confucian teachings.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Peperiksaan perkhidmatan awam terdiri daripada Xiucai, Juren dan Jinshi; ia ketat, kompetitif, dan terbuka kepada lelaki tanpa mengira latar belakang.
text_en: Civil service examinations consisted of Xiucai, Juren, and Jinshi; they were strict, competitive, and open to males regardless of background.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Tamadun China berkembang melalui beberapa dinasti termasuk Shang, Zhou, Qin, Han dan Tang.
text_en: Chinese civilisation developed through dynasties including the Shang, Zhou, Qin, Han and Tang.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Sumbangan Tamadun China termasuk kertas, kompas, serbuk letupan dan teknik percetakan.
text_en: Chinese contributions include paper, the compass, gunpowder and printing techniques.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Beliau menyatukan China pada tahun 221 SM dan menyeragamkan tulisan, mata wang serta sukatan timbang. Beliau juga mengarahkan penyambungan tembok pertahanan yang menjadi asas Tembok Besar China.
text_en: He unified China in 221 BC and standardised writing, currency and weights and measures. He also ordered defensive walls to be linked, forming the basis of the Great Wall of China.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Maharaja yang menyatukan China pada tahun 221 SM ialah / The emperor who unified China in 221 BC was
choice_a: Qin Shi Huang
choice_b: Asoka
choice_c: Confucius
choice_d: Han Wudi
answer: Qin Shi Huang

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
