text: Antara sumbangan Tamadun China kepada dunia ialah / Among Chinese civilisation's contributions to the world is
choice_a: Kertas dan kompas / Paper and the compass
choice_b: Kod undang-undang Hammurabi / The Code of Hammurabi
choice_c: Sistem demokrasi / The democratic system
choice_d: Piramid batu / Stone pyramids
answer: Kertas dan kompas / Paper and the compass

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Ajaran Confucius menekankan / Confucian teaching emphasised
choice_a: Nilai moral, hormat kepada keluarga dan ketaatan sosial / Moral values, respect for family and social order
choice_b: Pemerintahan tanpa undang-undang / Rule without law
choice_c: Peperangan sebagai jalan penyelesaian / War as a solution
choice_d: Penolakan terhadap pendidikan / Rejection of education
answer: Nilai moral, hormat kepada keluarga dan ketaatan sosial / Moral values, respect for family and social order

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Tembok Besar China dibina terutamanya untuk / The Great Wall of China was built mainly to
choice_a: Mempertahankan wilayah daripada serangan dari utara / Defend the realm from northern attacks
choice_b: Menyimpan hasil pertanian / Store farm produce
choice_c: Menghubungkan pelabuhan perdagangan / Link trading ports
choice_d: Mengalirkan air ke bandar / Carry water to cities
answer: Mempertahankan wilayah daripada serangan dari utara / Defend the realm from northern attacks

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Sistem peperiksaan awam dalam Tamadun China bertujuan untuk / The civil examination system in Chinese civilisation aimed to
choice_a: Memilih pegawai berdasarkan ilmu dan kebolehan / Select officials based on knowledge and ability
choice_b: Memilih pegawai berdasarkan keturunan sahaja / Select officials by lineage alone
choice_c: Menentukan pemimpin tentera sahaja / Choose only military leaders
choice_d: Mengagihkan tanah kepada rakyat / Distribute land to the people
answer: Memilih pegawai berdasarkan ilmu dan kebolehan / Select officials based on knowledge and ability

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Nyatakan dua sumbangan Tamadun China kepada dunia. / State two contributions of Chinese civilisation to the world.
answer: Penciptaan kertas yang memudahkan penyebaran ilmu, dan kompas yang membantu pelayaran serta penerokaan. / The invention of paper, which eased the spread of knowledge, and the compass, which aided navigation and exploration.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Jelaskan langkah penyeragaman yang dilakukan oleh Qin Shi Huang. / Explain the standardisation carried out by Qin Shi Huang.
answer: Beliau menyeragamkan tulisan, mata wang, sukatan timbang dan lebar roda kereta supaya pentadbiran dan perdagangan lebih mudah di seluruh empayar. / He standardised writing, currency, weights and measures and cart axle widths so administration and trade were easier across the empire.

chapter: Bab 7: Peningkatan Tamadun India dan China
text: Mengapakah ajaran Confucius penting kepada masyarakat China? / Why was Confucian teaching important to Chinese society?
answer: Ajarannya menetapkan nilai moral, hormat kepada keluarga dan tanggungjawab pemerintah, lalu menjadi asas keharmonian dan pentadbiran masyarakat. / His teaching set out moral values, respect for family and the duties of rulers, forming the basis of social harmony and administration.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Topik ini membincangkan masyarakat Arab sebelum Islam, termasuk kehidupan padang pasir, agama, adat, dan kehidupan seharian.
text_en: This topic discusses Arab society before Islam, including desert life, religion, customs, and daily life.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Masyarakat Arab hidup dalam persekitaran padang pasir dengan gaya hidup nomad dan kampung.
text_en: Arab society lived in a desert environment with nomadic and village lifestyles.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Mereka mengamalkan pelbagai kepercayaan, termasuk penyembahan berhala dan tradisi lisan.
text_en: They practiced various beliefs, including idol worship and oral traditions.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Adat dan kehidupan seharian menekankan nilai kekeluargaan, maruah, dan perdagangan.
text_en: Their customs and daily life emphasized family, honor, and trade.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Kebudayaan mereka dipengaruhi oleh iklim padang pasir dan hubungan dengan suku-suku lain.
text_en: Their culture was shaped by the desert climate and relations with other tribes.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Keadaan masyarakat ini menyediakan latar untuk kemunculan Islam.
text_en: These conditions provided the background for the emergence of Islam.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Zaman sebelum kedatangan Islam dikenali sebagai Zaman Jahiliah kerana masyarakatnya jahil tentang ajaran tauhid.
text_en: The era before Islam is known as the Age of Jahiliyyah because society was ignorant of monotheistic teaching.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Masyarakat Arab Jahiliah menyembah berhala, mengamalkan perhambaan dan sering berperang antara kabilah.
text_en: Jahiliyyah Arab society worshipped idols, practised slavery and often fought between tribes.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Beliau merupakan antara penyair paling terkenal sebelum kedatangan Islam dan karyanya tergolong dalam kumpulan al-Mu'allaqat. Puisinya menjadi sumber penting tentang nilai, adat dan kehidupan masyarakat Arab ketika itu.
text_en: He was among the most celebrated poets before Islam and his work is counted among the Mu'allaqat. His poetry is an important source on the values, customs and life of Arab society then.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Zaman sebelum kedatangan Islam di Tanah Arab dikenali sebagai / The era before Islam in Arabia is known as
choice_a: Zaman Jahiliah / The Age of Jahiliyyah
choice_b: Zaman Khulafa al-Rasyidin
choice_c: Zaman Abbasiyah / The Abbasid era
choice_d: Zaman Umayyah / The Umayyad era
answer: Zaman Jahiliah / The Age of Jahiliyyah

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Antara ciri masyarakat Arab Jahiliah ialah / A feature of Jahiliyyah Arab society was
choice_a: Menyembah berhala dan berperang antara kabilah / Idol worship and inter-tribal warfare
choice_b: Mengamalkan sistem demokrasi / Practising democracy
choice_c: Menyembah satu tuhan sahaja / Worshipping one God only
choice_d: Mengharamkan perhambaan / Prohibiting slavery
answer: Menyembah berhala dan berperang antara kabilah / Idol worship and inter-tribal warfare

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Kegiatan ekonomi utama masyarakat Arab sebelum Islam ialah / The main economic activity of pre-Islamic Arabs was
choice_a: Perdagangan dan penternakan / Trade and animal herding
choice_b: Perlombongan emas / Gold mining
choice_c: Perikanan laut dalam / Deep-sea fishing
choice_d: Perindustrian tekstil / Textile manufacturing
answer: Perdagangan dan penternakan / Trade and animal herding

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Kabilah penting yang menjaga Kaabah di Makkah sebelum Islam ialah / The important tribe guarding the Kaabah in Mecca before Islam was
choice_a: Quraisy / Quraysh
choice_b: Aus
choice_c: Khazraj
choice_d: Ghassan
answer: Quraisy / Quraysh

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Puisi Arab zaman Jahiliah penting sebagai / Jahiliyyah Arab poetry is important as
choice_a: Sumber sejarah tentang nilai dan adat masyarakat ketika itu / A historical source on the values and customs of that society
choice_b: Kitab undang-undang rasmi / An official law code
choice_c: Rekod cukai perdagangan / Trade tax records
choice_d: Peta laluan perdagangan / A map of trade routes
answer: Sumber sejarah tentang nilai dan adat masyarakat ketika itu / A historical source on the values and customs of that society

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Nyatakan dua ciri masyarakat Arab pada Zaman Jahiliah. / State two features of Arab society in the Age of Jahiliyyah.
answer: Mereka menyembah berhala dan tidak mengenal ajaran tauhid, serta sering berperang sesama kabilah kerana semangat assabiah. / They worshipped idols and did not know monotheism, and often fought between tribes out of tribal loyalty.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Mengapakah zaman sebelum Islam digelar Zaman Jahiliah? / Why is the era before Islam called the Age of Jahiliyyah?
answer: Kerana masyarakatnya jahil tentang ajaran tauhid dan akhlak yang benar, walaupun mereka mahir dalam bidang seperti puisi dan perdagangan. / Because society was ignorant of monotheism and true morality, even though it excelled in fields such as poetry and trade.

topic: 8.1 Latar Belakang Masyarakat Arab Sebelum Kedatangan Islam
text: Jelaskan kepentingan Makkah kepada masyarakat Arab sebelum Islam. / Explain the importance of Mecca to Arabs before Islam.
answer: Makkah menjadi pusat perdagangan dan tempat kunjungan kerana terdapat Kaabah, menjadikannya tumpuan kabilah dari seluruh Tanah Arab. / Mecca was a trading hub and place of pilgrimage because of the Kaabah, drawing tribes from across Arabia.

text: Topik ini menerangkan kemunculan Islam dan perkembangan tamadun Islam melalui zaman Khalifah dan kerajaan besar.
text_en: This topic explains the emergence of Islam and the development of Islamic civilization through the eras of caliphs and great empires.

text: Islam mula berkembang di Jazirah Arab dan bertapak semasa era Khulafa ar-Rashidin.
text_en: Islam began to grow in the Arabian Peninsula and took root during the Rashidun Caliphate.

text: Abu Bakar al-Siddiq mengukuhkan umat Islam selepas kewafatan Nabi Muhammad SAW.
text_en: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq strengthened the Muslim community after the Prophet Muhammad SAW passed away.

text: Zaman Umar dan Uthman menyaksikan perkembangan wilayah melalui penaklukan dan pentadbiran.
text_en: The eras of Umar and Uthman saw territorial expansion through conquest and administration.

text: Daulah Umaiyah meluaskan Islam hingga ke Sepanyol, manakala Abbasiyah berkembang hingga Transoxania.
text_en: The Umayyad Caliphate expanded Islam to Spain, while the Abbasid Caliphate reached Transoxania.

text: Tamadun Islam mula membina pusat intelektual dan ilmu pengetahuan.
text_en: Islamic civilization began to establish intellectual centers and scholarship.

text: Islam disebarkan di Makkah secara rahsia selama tiga tahun sebelum dilakukan secara terbuka.
text_en: Islam was spread secretly in Mecca for three years before being preached openly.

text: Hijrah ke Madinah pada tahun 622 Masihi menjadi titik permulaan kalendar Hijrah dan pembinaan negara Islam.
text_en: The migration to Medina in 622 CE marks the start of the Hijri calendar and the founding of the Islamic state.

text: Beliau memperluas wilayah Islam ke Parsi, Syam dan Mesir serta memperkenalkan sistem pentadbiran wilayah, perbendaharaan negara (Baitulmal) dan kalendar Hijrah. Pemerintahannya menyusun asas pentadbiran negara Islam yang tersusun.
text_en: He expanded Islamic territory into Persia, Syria and Egypt and introduced provincial administration, the state treasury (Baitulmal) and the Hijri calendar. His rule laid an organised administrative foundation for the Islamic state.

text: Hijrah Nabi Muhammad SAW ke Madinah berlaku pada tahun / The Prophet Muhammad's migration to Medina took place in
choice_a: 622 Masihi / 622 CE
choice_b: 570 Masihi / 570 CE
choice_c: 632 Masihi / 632 CE
choice_d: 610 Masihi / 610 CE
answer: 622 Masihi / 622 CE

text: Piagam Madinah penting kerana ia / The Charter of Medina is important because it
choice_a: Menjadi perlembagaan bertulis yang mengatur hubungan pelbagai kaum dan agama / Was a written constitution governing relations between different peoples and faiths
choice_b: Mengisytiharkan perang terhadap semua kabilah / Declared war on all tribes
choice_c: Menetapkan kadar cukai perdagangan sahaja / Set only trade tax rates
choice_d: Melarang perdagangan di Madinah / Banned trade in Medina
answer: Menjadi perlembagaan bertulis yang mengatur hubungan pelbagai kaum dan agama / Was a written constitution governing relations between different peoples and faiths

text: Khalifah pertama selepas kewafatan Nabi Muhammad SAW ialah / The first caliph after the Prophet Muhammad's passing was
choice_a: Abu Bakar al-Siddiq
choice_b: Umar al-Khattab
choice_c: Uthman bin Affan
choice_d: Ali bin Abi Talib
answer: Abu Bakar al-Siddiq

text: Kalendar Hijrah diperkenalkan pada zaman pemerintahan / The Hijri calendar was introduced during the rule of
choice_a: Umar al-Khattab
choice_b: Abu Bakar al-Siddiq
choice_c: Ali bin Abi Talib
choice_d: Muawiyah
answer: Umar al-Khattab

text: Baitulmal dalam pentadbiran Islam berfungsi sebagai / The Baitulmal in Islamic administration functioned as
choice_a: Perbendaharaan negara untuk menguruskan harta dan kebajikan rakyat / A state treasury managing wealth and public welfare
choice_b: Pusat latihan tentera / A military training centre
choice_c: Dewan perhimpunan rakyat / A popular assembly hall
choice_d: Sekolah pengajian bahasa / A language school
answer: Perbendaharaan negara untuk menguruskan harta dan kebajikan rakyat / A state treasury managing wealth and public welfare

text: Jelaskan kepentingan peristiwa Hijrah ke Madinah. / Explain the importance of the migration to Medina.
answer: Hijrah membolehkan umat Islam membina masyarakat dan negara Islam yang aman di Madinah, serta menjadi titik permulaan kalendar Hijrah. / The Hijrah allowed Muslims to build a peaceful society and Islamic state in Medina, and marks the start of the Hijri calendar.

text: Nyatakan dua isi penting Piagam Madinah. / State two key contents of the Charter of Medina.
answer: Ia menetapkan kebebasan beragama bagi semua penduduk dan menyatukan mereka untuk mempertahankan Madinah daripada serangan luar. / It guaranteed freedom of religion for all residents and united them to defend Medina against outside attack.

text: Nyatakan dua sumbangan pentadbiran Khalifah Umar al-Khattab. / State two administrative contributions of Caliph Umar al-Khattab.
answer: Beliau memperkenalkan pembahagian wilayah dengan gabenor serta menubuhkan Baitulmal untuk menguruskan kewangan negara. / He introduced provincial divisions with governors and established the Baitulmal to manage state finances.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Topik ini menyorot peranan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai pemimpin negara, masyarakat dan tentera dalam sejarah Islam awal.
text_en: This topic highlights the role of Prophet Muhammad SAW as a state, community, and military leader in early Islamic history.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Nabi Muhammad SAW diiktiraf sebagai pemimpin rohani, politik dan sosial bagi umat Islam.
text_en: Prophet Muhammad SAW is recognized as the spiritual, political, and social leader of Muslims.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Beliau mengurus negeri Madinah dan menyusun masyarakat berbilang kaum.
text_en: He managed the state of Medina and organized a plural society.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Prinsip kepimpinannya termasuk keadilan, toleransi dan kerjasama antara rakyat.
text_en: His leadership principles included justice, tolerance, and cooperation among people.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Sebagai pemimpin tentera, beliau memimpin peristiwa penting seperti Badar, Uhud dan Khandaq.
text_en: As a military leader, he led important events like Badr, Uhud, and the Trench.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Kepimpinan beliau membantu membentuk asas negara Islam yang adil dan teratur.
text_en: His leadership helped build the foundations of a just and orderly Islamic state.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Nabi Muhammad SAW digelar al-Amin sejak muda kerana sifat jujur dan amanah baginda.
text_en: The Prophet Muhammad SAW was called al-Amin from a young age for his honesty and trustworthiness.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Baginda menyelesaikan pertelingkahan kabilah ketika meletakkan semula Hajar Aswad dengan cara yang adil.
text_en: He resolved a tribal dispute over replacing the Black Stone in a fair manner.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Baginda memimpin umat Islam dalam bidang agama, pentadbiran, perundangan dan pertahanan, serta menyatukan masyarakat Madinah melalui Piagam Madinah. Sifat amanah, adil dan bertolak ansur baginda menjadi teladan kepemimpinan sehingga kini.
text_en: He led the Muslim community in religion, administration, law and defence, and united the people of Medina through its Charter. His trustworthiness, fairness and tolerance remain a model of leadership today.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Gelaran al-Amin yang diberikan kepada Nabi Muhammad SAW bermaksud / The title al-Amin given to Prophet Muhammad SAW means
choice_a: Yang dipercayai / The trustworthy
choice_b: Yang berani / The brave
choice_c: Yang kaya / The wealthy
choice_d: Yang bijak berperang / The skilled warrior
answer: Yang dipercayai / The trustworthy

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Nabi Muhammad SAW menyelesaikan pertelingkahan kabilah Quraisy berkaitan / Prophet Muhammad SAW resolved a Quraysh tribal dispute concerning
choice_a: Peletakan semula Hajar Aswad / The replacement of the Black Stone
choice_b: Pembahagian hasil perdagangan / The division of trade profits
choice_c: Pemilihan ketua kabilah / The choice of a tribal chief
choice_d: Pembinaan telaga zamzam / The building of the Zamzam well
answer: Peletakan semula Hajar Aswad / The replacement of the Black Stone

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Antara ciri kepemimpinan Nabi Muhammad SAW ialah / A feature of Prophet Muhammad's leadership was
choice_a: Adil, amanah dan bertolak ansur / Fair, trustworthy and tolerant
choice_b: Memerintah tanpa berunding / Ruling without consultation
choice_c: Mengutamakan golongan kaya / Favouring the wealthy
choice_d: Menolak perdamaian / Rejecting peace
answer: Adil, amanah dan bertolak ansur / Fair, trustworthy and tolerant

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Perjanjian Hudaibiyah menunjukkan sifat baginda yang / The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah shows the Prophet's quality of
choice_a: Mengutamakan perdamaian dan berfikiran jauh / Prioritising peace and long-term thinking
choice_b: Cepat marah / Quick temper
choice_c: Menolak rundingan / Refusal to negotiate
choice_d: Mengutamakan kekayaan / Prioritising wealth
answer: Mengutamakan perdamaian dan berfikiran jauh / Prioritising peace and long-term thinking

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Amalan syura yang diamalkan baginda bermaksud / The practice of syura followed by the Prophet means
choice_a: Bermesyuarat untuk membuat keputusan bersama / Consulting to make decisions together
choice_b: Memberi hadiah kepada pengikut / Giving gifts to followers
choice_c: Melantik pemimpin secara warisan / Appointing leaders by inheritance
choice_d: Menetapkan cukai perdagangan / Setting trade taxes
answer: Bermesyuarat untuk membuat keputusan bersama / Consulting to make decisions together

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Nyatakan dua sifat kepemimpinan Nabi Muhammad SAW yang boleh dicontohi. / State two of the Prophet's leadership qualities worth emulating.
answer: Sifat amanah dalam menjalankan tanggungjawab dan sifat adil dalam membuat keputusan tanpa memihak kepada mana-mana pihak. / Trustworthiness in carrying out responsibilities and fairness in making decisions without favouring any side.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Jelaskan bagaimana baginda menyelesaikan pertelingkahan Hajar Aswad. / Explain how the Prophet resolved the Black Stone dispute.
answer: Baginda meletakkan Hajar Aswad di atas sehelai kain dan meminta wakil setiap kabilah memegang hujung kain untuk mengangkatnya bersama-sama. / He placed the Black Stone on a cloth and asked a representative of each tribe to hold an edge so they lifted it together.

topic: 8.3 Ketokohan Nabi Muhammad SAW sebagai Pemimpin
text: Mengapakah amalan syura penting dalam kepemimpinan? / Why is the practice of syura important in leadership?
answer: Syura membolehkan pandangan ramai diambil kira sebelum keputusan dibuat, menghasilkan keputusan yang lebih adil dan diterima bersama. / Syura allows many views to be considered before a decision, producing fairer and more widely accepted outcomes.

text: Topik ini membincangkan sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam bidang politik, ekonomi, sosial dan ilmu pengetahuan.
text_en: This topic discusses the contributions of Islamic civilization in politics, economy, society, and knowledge.

text: Tamadun Islam menyumbang dalam politik melalui sistem khalifah dan undang-undang Islam.
text_en: Islamic civilization contributed politically through the caliphate system and Islamic law.

text: Ekonomi Islam berkembang melalui perdagangan, pertanian dan sistem kewangan berlandaskan zakat.
text_en: Islamic economy developed through trade, agriculture, and finance based on zakat.

text: Aspek sosial termasuk perpaduan, pendidikan dan kemajuan kebudayaan dalam masyarakat Islam.
text_en: Social aspects included unity, education, and cultural advancement in Muslim societies.

text: Pusat intelektual seperti Baghdad menjadi pusat ilmu, sains dan falsafah.
text_en: Intellectual centers such as Baghdad became hubs for knowledge, science, and philosophy.

text: Ilmuan Islam seperti Al-Khwarizmi dan Ibnu Sina memberikan sumbangan penting kepada dunia.
text_en: Islamic scholars like Al-Khwarizmi and Ibn Sina made important contributions to the world.

text: Baitulhikmah di Baghdad menjadi pusat ilmu tempat karya Yunani, Parsi dan India diterjemah ke bahasa Arab.
text_en: Baitulhikmah in Baghdad was a centre of learning where Greek, Persian and Indian works were translated into Arabic.

text: Tamadun Islam memperkenalkan hospital awam (bimaristan) yang menyediakan rawatan percuma dan latihan perubatan.
text_en: Islamic civilisation introduced public hospitals (bimaristan) offering free treatment and medical training.

text: Beliau dikenali sebagai bapa algebra melalui karyanya tentang al-jabr dan memperkenalkan penggunaan angka Hindu-Arab kepada dunia. Nama beliau menjadi asas kepada istilah 'algoritma' yang digunakan dalam komputer hari ini.
text_en: He is known as the father of algebra through his work on al-jabr and introduced Hindu-Arabic numerals to the wider world. His name is the root of the term 'algorithm' used in computing today.

text: Beliau menulis 'al-Qanun fi al-Tibb' yang menjadi rujukan utama perubatan di Eropah selama berabad-abad. Karyanya menyusun ilmu perubatan secara sistematik termasuk diagnosis, ubat-ubatan dan pembedahan.
text_en: He wrote 'al-Qanun fi al-Tibb', a leading medical reference in Europe for centuries. His work organised medical knowledge systematically, covering diagnosis, medicines and surgery.

text: Al-Khwarizmi dikenali sebagai bapa / Al-Khwarizmi is known as the father of
choice_a: Algebra
choice_b: Perubatan moden / Modern medicine
choice_c: Sejarah / History
choice_d: Seni bina / Architecture
answer: Algebra

text: Karya perubatan Ibn Sina yang terkenal ialah / Ibn Sina's famous medical work is
choice_a: Al-Qanun fi al-Tibb
choice_b: Muqaddimah
choice_c: Al-Jabr
choice_d: Kitab al-Manazir
answer: Al-Qanun fi al-Tibb

text: Baitulhikmah di Baghdad berfungsi sebagai / Baitulhikmah in Baghdad functioned as
choice_a: Pusat ilmu dan penterjemahan karya asing / A centre of learning and translation of foreign works
choice_b: Kubu pertahanan tentera / A military fortress
choice_c: Pasar perdagangan utama / A main trading market
choice_d: Istana khalifah / The caliph's palace
answer: Pusat ilmu dan penterjemahan karya asing / A centre of learning and translation of foreign works

text: Istilah 'algoritma' berasal daripada nama / The term 'algorithm' derives from the name of
choice_a: Al-Khwarizmi
choice_b: Ibn Sina
choice_c: Ibn Khaldun
choice_d: Al-Biruni
answer: Al-Khwarizmi

text: Bimaristan dalam tamadun Islam ialah / A bimaristan in Islamic civilisation was
choice_a: Hospital awam yang menyediakan rawatan dan latihan perubatan / A public hospital providing treatment and medical training
choice_b: Sekolah tentera / A military school
choice_c: Perpustakaan diraja sahaja / A royal library only
choice_d: Tempat penyimpanan bijirin / A grain store
answer: Hospital awam yang menyediakan rawatan dan latihan perubatan / A public hospital providing treatment and medical training

text: Nyatakan dua sumbangan tamadun Islam dalam bidang ilmu. / State two contributions of Islamic civilisation in the field of knowledge.
answer: Perkembangan algebra dan angka Hindu-Arab oleh al-Khwarizmi, serta penyusunan ilmu perubatan secara sistematik oleh Ibn Sina. / The development of algebra and Hindu-Arabic numerals by al-Khwarizmi, and the systematic organisation of medicine by Ibn Sina.

text: Jelaskan peranan Baitulhikmah dalam perkembangan ilmu. / Explain the role of Baitulhikmah in the growth of knowledge.
answer: Baitulhikmah mengumpul dan menterjemah karya Yunani, Parsi dan India ke bahasa Arab, lalu menjadi pusat kajian yang menyebarkan ilmu ke seluruh dunia. / Baitulhikmah collected and translated Greek, Persian and Indian works into Arabic, becoming a research centre that spread knowledge worldwide.

text: Bagaimanakah sumbangan tamadun Islam mempengaruhi Eropah? / How did Islamic contributions influence Europe?
answer: Karya sains dan perubatan Islam diterjemah ke bahasa Latin dan menjadi teks rujukan universiti Eropah, membantu mencetuskan perkembangan ilmu di sana. / Islamic scientific and medical works were translated into Latin and used as university texts in Europe, helping spark its intellectual growth.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Topik ini menerangkan ciri seni bina Islam dan bagaimana ia memberi inspirasi kepada pembinaan masjid, istana, dan ruang awam.
text_en: This topic explains the features of Islamic architecture and how it inspired the construction of mosques, palaces, and public spaces.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Seni bina Islam terkenal dengan kubah, menara, lengkungan dan corak geometri.
text_en: Islamic architecture is known for domes, minarets, arches, and geometric patterns.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Bangunan seperti masjid dan istana mencerminkan nilai keagamaan dan estetika.
text_en: Buildings such as mosques and palaces reflect religious values and aesthetics.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Reka bentuk seni bina Islam sering menggunakan taman, air mancur dan kaligrafi.
text_en: Islamic architectural design often uses gardens, fountains, and calligraphy.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Cordoba dan Baghdad adalah contoh bandar dengan bangunan seni bina Islam yang megah.
text_en: Cordoba and Baghdad are examples of cities with magnificent Islamic architecture.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Sumbangan seni bina Islam terus memberi inspirasi kepada seni bina di seluruh dunia.
text_en: The contribution of Islamic architecture continues to inspire architecture worldwide.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Ciri seni bina Islam termasuk kubah, menara, lengkungan dan hiasan kaligrafi serta motif geometri.
text_en: Features of Islamic architecture include domes, minarets, arches and decoration with calligraphy and geometric motifs.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Masjid berfungsi bukan sahaja sebagai tempat ibadat tetapi juga pusat ilmu dan kegiatan masyarakat.
text_en: Mosques served not only as places of worship but also as centres of learning and community activity.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Beliau mereka bentuk lebih tiga ratus binaan termasuk Masjid Selimiye di Edirne yang terkenal dengan kubah besarnya. Reka bentuk beliau menggabungkan kekuatan struktur dengan keindahan ruang dalaman yang lapang.
text_en: He designed more than three hundred structures, including the Selimiye Mosque in Edirne, famed for its great dome. His designs combined structural strength with the beauty of spacious interiors.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Antara ciri utama seni bina Islam ialah / A main feature of Islamic architecture is
choice_a: Kubah, menara dan hiasan kaligrafi / Domes, minarets and calligraphic decoration
choice_b: Patung dewa di pintu masuk / Statues of deities at the entrance
choice_c: Lukisan wajah manusia pada dinding dalam / Portraits of human faces on interior walls
choice_d: Tiang berukir bentuk haiwan besar / Pillars carved as large animals
answer: Kubah, menara dan hiasan kaligrafi / Domes, minarets and calligraphic decoration

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Menara pada masjid berfungsi untuk / A minaret on a mosque functions to
choice_a: Melaungkan azan kepada penduduk sekitar / Call the adhan to the surrounding community
choice_b: Menyimpan hasil zakat / Store zakat collections
choice_c: Menempatkan pengawal keselamatan / House security guards
choice_d: Mengalirkan air hujan / Drain rainwater
answer: Melaungkan azan kepada penduduk sekitar / Call the adhan to the surrounding community

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Hiasan dalam seni bina Islam banyak menggunakan motif / Islamic architectural decoration largely uses motifs of
choice_a: Geometri, tumbuhan dan kaligrafi / Geometry, plants and calligraphy
choice_b: Wajah pemerintah / Rulers' faces
choice_c: Haiwan buas / Wild animals
choice_d: Dewa dan dewi / Gods and goddesses
answer: Geometri, tumbuhan dan kaligrafi / Geometry, plants and calligraphy

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Masjid Selimiye di Edirne direka oleh / The Selimiye Mosque in Edirne was designed by
choice_a: Mimar Sinan
choice_b: Al-Khwarizmi
choice_c: Ibn Sina
choice_d: Vitruvius
answer: Mimar Sinan

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Selain tempat ibadat, masjid pada zaman tamadun Islam juga berfungsi sebagai / Besides worship, mosques in Islamic civilisation also served as
choice_a: Pusat ilmu dan kegiatan masyarakat / Centres of learning and community activity
choice_b: Pusat latihan tentera sahaja / Military training centres only
choice_c: Gudang perdagangan / Trade warehouses
choice_d: Istana pemerintah / Rulers' palaces
answer: Pusat ilmu dan kegiatan masyarakat / Centres of learning and community activity

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Nyatakan tiga ciri seni bina Islam. / State three features of Islamic architecture.
answer: Kubah yang besar, menara untuk azan, dan hiasan berbentuk kaligrafi serta motif geometri. / Large domes, minarets for the call to prayer, and decoration using calligraphy and geometric motifs.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Mengapakah seni bina Islam mengelakkan patung dan gambar makhluk hidup? / Why does Islamic architecture avoid statues and images of living beings?
answer: Ajaran Islam melarang pemujaan berhala, jadi hiasan tertumpu kepada kaligrafi, motif geometri dan tumbuhan. / Islamic teaching forbids idol worship, so decoration focuses on calligraphy, geometric motifs and plant forms.

topic: 8.5 Sumbangan Tamadun Islam dalam Bidang Seni Bina
text: Jelaskan peranan masjid dalam masyarakat Islam. / Explain the role of the mosque in Muslim society.
answer: Masjid menjadi tempat ibadat, pusat pengajaran ilmu, tempat bermesyuarat dan pusat kebajikan masyarakat. / The mosque is a place of worship, a centre for teaching, a meeting place and a hub for community welfare.
